title: Junior Designer for UK Art Print Brand (Long-term, Collaborative Role)
description:
We're a UK-based e-commerce brand selling personalised art prints. We have thousands of happy customers, a 4.9-star rating, and a growing catalogue. We're looking for a designer to join us long-term and grow with the brand.



This is a great fit if you're early in your design career (a recent graphic design graduate would do this well) and want steady, ongoing work rather than one-off gigs.



What you'll do day-to-day:



- Personalise our existing art print templates. Adding customer-supplied text into pre-built layouts and choosing placement so it looks beautiful and on-brand

- Build linked smart object mockups in Photoshop: we provide the scene (e.g. a framed print on a wall), you create and link the smart object layer cleanly, and save a reusable PSD that others can drop artwork into. We'll show you exactly how we like these built.

- Place artwork into scene mockups for our website and social media

- Help us create new art pieces: we provide the artwork, you choose fonts, pairings, and layout. This is the collaborative, creative part we're most excited to build with the right person.

- Create social media graphics at correct sizes for each platform



What we're looking for:



- A genuine eye for typography. Font choice, pairing, and placement is the heart of this role

- Comfortable in Photoshop, especially smart objects and editable layers (this is a core part of the job. Some experience here matters, but we're happy to train the right person who has the fundamentals)

- Familiar with Canva and Photopea, and aware of their limitations vs Photoshop

- Fluent, comfortable written English

- A quick learner who's reliable and available long-term

- Stable, fast internet



You don't need years of experience or to be a senior designer. We care more about taste, reliability, and wanting this job specifically.



How to apply:







Please apply through our form above. We read every one. Applicants who reply directly to this post instead of using the form won't be considered.

title: AI Automation Specialist
description:
AI Automation Specialist

Work Setup: Remote, Full-time hours — 3-month contract (with potential to extend and grow into a lead role)



Pay: Monthly contract salary, $960–$1,280/month (equivalent to ~$6–$8/hour, based on ~160 hours/month), depending on experience. Strong builders at the top of the range.



About the Role:

SLB In-Home Care is building AI + automation to run our back office and speed up how we serve families. We're looking for an AI Automation Specialist to build and maintain our automations — trackers, integrations, and AI agents that keep our documentation, scheduling, and operations running with less manual work.



You do not need to know our specific program—we provide training. This is a 3-month contract with a direct path to Automation Lead, coordinating a small automation team.



Responsibilities:



- Build and maintain automations in GoHighLevel (workflows, SMS/text flows, forms, e-sign)

- Build automation "glue" between our tools (ClickUp, GoHighLevel, DocuSign, Google Drive) using n8n / Make / Zapier, APIs, and webhooks

- Set up ClickUp tracker agents (supervisory visits, renewals, PPOT, DVN, deadlines) that alert us automatically

- Build simple AI agents/chatbots grounded in our knowledge base

- Add monitoring so we know the moment an automation breaks

- Write plain-English documentation so a non-technical owner can run and shut off any automation

- Keep everything organized in our own accounts

- Work closely with the team and take coaching as needed



Requirements



Must have:

- Real automation experience (GoHighLevel + n8n / Make / Zapier)

- Experience building AI agents or chatbots connected to a knowledge base

- Connecting apps via API and webhooks

- Strong attention to detail and problem-solving



Preferred:

- ClickUp automations

- Some scripting (Python or JavaScript)

- Experience self-hosting n8n



Bonus:

- Voice AI agents (Vapi / Retell)

- Dashboards / reporting



Important:



Please do not apply if you only have general VA experience without real automation/building experience. Candidates should be able to show a real automation they built that is still running months later.



How to Apply:

Please send your updated resume and a short Loom video introducing yourself and your relevant automation experience, then include a brief response to the following:



1. How many years of automation experience do you have?

2. Which tools do you use most (GoHighLevel, n8n, Make, Zapier, ClickUp)?

3. Share 1–2 automations you built that are still running — links or a quick demo.

4. Have you built an AI agent/chatbot grounded in a knowledge base? Briefly describe.

5. Give one example of an automation that broke — how did you find out and fix it?



Only candidates with real automation experience will be considered. This role can grow into an Automation Lead position.

title: Virtual Assistant - Clinician Coordinator
description:
Role: Clinician Relations Virtual Assistant



Location: 100% Remote (Must be located outside the United States)



Employment Type: Full-Time Remote Contractor



Compensation: $600 – $800 USD per month



Hours: 40 hours/week, primarily EST/PST business hours



About Josi Health



Josi Health is a fast-growing remote healthcare company focused on making autism and ADHD care more accessible, faster, and less stressful for families. Through a modern, tech-enabled care model, we help patients navigate evaluations and therapy with greater clarity, communication, and support. We are a small, highly collaborative team that values ownership, responsiveness, operational clarity, and calm execution under pressure.



About The Role



We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and articulate Clinician Relations Virtual Assistant to serve as the critical operational bridge between our clinical team and internal operations. Your primary goal is to keep clinical operations running seamlessly by managing clinician communication, scheduling, credentialing support, and administrative follow-through.



This role requires superb organizational capabilities, diplomatic communication skills, and high attention to detail. You will ensure our clinicians feel supported, informed, and equipped to focus on patient care without operational friction.



This is not a basic administrative role. We need an autonomous problem-solver who can manage multiple operational workflows, maintain strict confidentiality, and handle professional relationships with clinicians with authority and grace.



Key Responsibilities



Clinical Coordination: Act as the main point of contact for clinicians regarding scheduling, calendar availability, assignment updates, and daily operational questions.



Operations Bridge: Facilitate daily alignment between the operations team and clinical providers to resolve workflow bottlenecks, system updates, and patient handoffs.



Administrative Management: Collect, organize, and verify clinical documentation, licensing, insurance credentialing files, and compliance records.



Workflow Oversight: Monitor clinical documentation submission timelines and proactively follow up with providers to maintain compliance and steady care velocity.



Process Optimization: Identify recurring communication gaps or operational friction points between clinical and ops teams and propose clear, practical improvements.



System Maintenance: Maintain accurate provider records, schedules, and notes across internal communication channels and operational software.





What We’re Looking For (Required Qualifications)



Exceptional written and spoken English communication skills with high professional polish.



Proven organizational skills, strong operational thinking, and rigorous attention to detail.



Ability to build trust and maintain professional, empathetic relationships with healthcare providers.



High autonomy: capable of managing complex schedules and follow-ups without constant supervision.



Reliable remote setup: high-speed internet, quiet workspace, and functional power/internet backups during outages.



Availability during US business hours (EST/PST).







Preferred Qualifications



Previous experience in virtual assistant roles, executive assistance, medical administration, or physician relations.



Experience in remote setups within fast-paced digital health, telehealth, or startup environments.



Hands-on familiarity with tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, EHR/EMR platforms, and project management tools (e.g., Asana, Notion).



General understanding of clinical workflows, HIPAA/privacy standards, or medical credentialing.







What We Offer



Fully remote work environment.



Competitive monthly compensation ($600 – $800 USD/month).



A supportive, high-accountability startup culture with zero micromanagement.



Opportunity to streamline clinical operations and impact quality of care directly.

mbers based in the Philippines, one of whom has been with us for over 3 years. We are now building out our video editing team and looking to bring on new editors immediately.

- Experience editing short-form video content for social media ads

- Proficiency in After Effects and/or CapCut

- A strong eye for pacing, transitions, and hooks that stop the scroll

- Ability to work from a creative brief and deliver without hand-holding

- Reliable internet connection and the ability to meet deadlines

- Comfortable working remotely and communicating via Loom and messaging tools

- Pay per completed video. Editors typically earn $500-1,000+ per month depending on output

- A growing agency with increasing volume month on month

- Clear briefs and asset packs for every project

- Creative freedom within our brand guidelines

- Direct feedback and support from our Creative Strategist

- Long-term working relationship for editors who consistently deliver quality

- A genuine path to full-time volume as the agency scales





HOW TO APPLY



We are hiring now and reviewing applications immediately.



IMPORTANT: Do not apply through OnlineJobs.ph. We will not review applications submitted through this platform.

title: Video Editor - Growing UK Agency (Pay Per Video, Long-Term)
description:
Location: Remote

Type: Part-Time to Full-Time (Pay Per Output)

Compensation: Paid per completed video ($500-1,000+ per month depending on output)





ABOUT US



New Leaf Media is the UK's leading marketing agency for landscaping and outdoor living companies. We have generated over 20 million pounds in revenue for our clients and every client we work with has come through word of mouth.



We are a team of 6, including 3 tea
mbers based in the Philippines, one of whom has been with us for over 3 years. We are now building out our video editing team and looking to bring on new editors immediately.





THE ROLE



We are looking for video editors who can turn raw footage and assets into scroll-stopping short-form video ads for Meta 
 and Instagram).



You will work directly with Joel, our Creative Strategist, who will brief you, review your work, and give you feedback on every project.



This is a pay-per-output role. You are paid for each completed video that passes our quality check. There is no fixed salary or hourly rate. The more you produce, the more you earn.



Volume will increase month on month as we onboard more clients and expand our creative output. Editors who deliver consistent quality will get more work over time. Our goal is to provide full-time volume to our best editors as we grow.





WHAT YOU WILL BE EDITING



- Short-form video ads (30 to 90 seconds)

- Before-and-after transformation videos

- Testimonial and talking-head edits

- Project showcase and montage videos

- Speed ramp and dynamic motion edits

- Text overlays, captions, and call-to-action graphics





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Experience editing short-form video content for social media ads

- Proficiency in After Effects and/or CapCut

- A strong eye for pacing, transitions, and hooks that stop the scroll

- Ability to work from a creative brief and deliver without hand-holding

- Reliable internet connection and the ability to meet deadlines

- Comfortable working remotely and communicating via Loom and messaging tools





WHAT WE OFFER



- Pay per completed video. Editors typically earn $500-1,000+ per month depending on output

- A growing agency with increasing volume month on month

- Clear briefs and asset packs for every project

- Creative freedom within our brand guidelines

- Direct feedback and support from our Creative Strategist

- Long-term working relationship for editors who consistently deliver quality

- A genuine path to full-time volume as the agency scales





HOW TO APPLY



We are hiring now and reviewing applications immediately.



IMPORTANT: Do not apply through OnlineJobs.ph. We will not review applications submitted through this platform.



You must apply using the link below:





Attention to detail check: Include the word LIME somewhere in your application. Applications without this will be ignored.



You will need to provide:



- A brief introduction about yourself and your editing experience

- A link to 1 to 3 short-form video edits you have done (ad-style content preferred)

- Which editing software you use

- Your per-video rate expectation or monthly earning goal

- Your availability and how many hours per week you can commit



We will review your examples and if we like what we see we will send you a paid trial task with a real brief and real assets so we can see how you work with our content.



We are looking to bring on 2 to 3 editors initially with room to grow as our client base expands.



Applications without a link to video examples will not be considered.

title: HIRING IMMEDIATELY!! Transaction Coordinator / REVA
description:
About the Company



LandCo Property Group is an established real estate investment company in Northeast Ohio, and we're expanding our team.



This is a stable, long-term opportunity with a company that values its people. We're not looking for someone to fill a seat for a month, we're looking for committed team members who want to grow with us. Perform well, and you'll have strong job security and a real career path in a business that's built to last.



What You'll Do



You'll be the connective hub across every real estate transaction, coordinating buyers, sellers, agents, lenders, and title companies from contract to close, while also providing executive and operations support that keeps the team running smoothly.



Transaction Coordination

- Coordinate transactions from contract to closing across purchase, sale, and wholesale deals

- Serve as the main point of contact for sellers and buyers throughout the transaction

- Track closing items and milestones, and help resolve documentation questions along the way

- Coordinate with title companies, lenders, and other third parties to keep timelines on track

- Manage transaction documentation, correspondence, and approvals



Operations Support

- Assist with internal operations, reporting, and documentation

- Help create and maintain SOPs and workflows that standardize recurring processes

- Contribute to internal systems and reporting tools (e.g., spreadsheets, tracking systems)



Somewhere in your application, include the word "rockstar" to show us you read the full job description. Applications without it will not be considered.



What We're Looking For

- At least 2 years of experience in U.S. real estate (transaction coordination, title/escrow, real estate admin, or similar)

- Excellent written and spoken English, you'll be communicating directly with U.S. buyers, sellers, agents, and lenders

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple files/deadlines at once

- Experience with GHL, Google Sheets, AI tools, and workflow automation

- A self-starter who takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do

Reliable, communicative, and committed to a long-term role, not just a short-term gig



Compensation & Schedule

- $6/hour (depending on experience), paid biweekly

- Full-time, 40 hours/week, Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM–7:00 PM EST

- Long-term growth potential into a lead Transaction Coordinator / Executive Assistant role for the right person

title: Tax Compliance Specialist (US-Based Company)
description:
Role Summary

The US State Tax Compliance Specialist will be responsible for guaranteeing timely compliance with all relevant US federal and, most critically, multi-state tax regulations. This role requires strong proficiency in US GAAP, accounting software, and a proactive approach to maintaining compliance across various state-level taxes.





State Tax Compliance and Research

1. Multi-State Sales & Use Tax: Monitor and track economic nexus requirements, calculate, file, and remit monthly/quarterly sales and use tax returns in multiple US states.

2. Business License & Registrations: Ensure the company maintains all necessary state and local business licenses and permits, including annual renewals.

3. Income/Franchise Tax Support: Prepare supporting documentation and schedules for the company's state income and franchise tax returns for review by a US CPA.

4. Compliance Monitoring: Stay current on changes to US state and local tax laws and regulations that impact the business (e.g., new nexus thresholds, rate changes).

5. Audit Support: Assist with gathering documentation and corresponding with state taxing authorities during audits or inquiries.





Qualifications:

1. Demonstrable working knowledge of US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).

2. Specific experience with multi-state sales tax compliance is a significant asset.

3. Certification (e.g., Certified Bookkeeper, Xero Certified Advisor) is a plus.

4. Applicants are required to provide two professional references who can attest to their job expertise

title: Performance Creative Director — Meta Ads | 30% Profit Share | $3k–$15k+ Potential
description:
We are an established ecommerce supplement brand looking for a highly creative, commercially minded **Performance Creative Director** to help us build and scale our Meta advertising.



This is not a traditional graphic designer role.



We are looking for someone who can think like a direct-response marketer and take ownership of the entire creative process:



* Research competitors, customers and winning ads

* Develop new hooks, angles and concepts

* Create or direct static ads, UGC and video ads

* Write strong ad copy and creative briefs

* Study performance data and understand why ads win or lose

* Iterate aggressively on winning concepts

* Continuously develop new creative tests



Our first major project will be a gut health / metabolic health supplement brand.



## Compensation



We want to create a structure where you can earn significantly more than a normal monthly salary.



You will receive **30% of the contribution profit generated by your winning creatives**.



For example:



If your ads generate $10,000 contribution profit → **you earn $3,000**



$30,000 contribution profit → **you earn $9,000**



$50,000 contribution profit → **you earn $15,000**



There is no fixed ceiling on what you can earn.



We fund the advertising spend and provide the products, funnel and infrastructure.



We are considering working with several creative partners initially. The people who consistently create profitable ads will receive more opportunities, responsibility and potentially a long-term leadership position within the company.



## Who We're Looking For



Ideally you have experience with:



* DTC ecommerce

* Meta/Facebook advertising

* Direct-response advertising

* Supplements, beauty or health products

* UGC concepts

* Static ads

* Video advertising

* Advertorial/VSL style funnels

* Creative testing at scale



You do **not** need to personally be the world's best video editor or graphic designer.



What matters most is that you can look at a product and customer and answer:



**What angle should we test?**



**What hook will stop someone scrolling?**



**Why would this person buy?**



**What should we test next based on the data?**



We want someone entrepreneurial who wants ownership and upside rather than simply completing assigned design tasks.



## To Apply



Please send:



1. Your best 3 ecommerce ads or creatives that you personally developed.

2. Examples of brands you have worked with.

3. Any Meta advertising results you can share.

4. Explain exactly what part of those winning ads you were responsible for.

5. Send a short Loom introducing yourself and explaining how you approach creative research and testing.

6. Start your application with the words **CREATIVE PARTNER** so we know you read the full post.



If you're looking for a standard VA position where you're simply given designs to make, this probably isn't the right role.



If you want the opportunity to **build winning campaigns, take ownership of creative strategy and participate directly in the profit you generate**, we'd like to speak with you.

title: AI & Systems Integration Specialist
description:
Cooper Roofing Inc.

AI & Systems Integration Specialist



Location: Remote (Philippines preferred). Applicants must maintain at least three hours of overlap with Vancouver business hours. Five to eight hours of overlap is ideal.



Connect the Systems That Will Power Our Growth



Cooper Roofing is an award-winning residential, commercial, and builder-focused roofing company serving Greater Vancouver and the Lower Mainland. We believe a modern roofing company should be organized, technology-driven, and committed to continuously improving the experience of both its customers and employees.







Our business currently operates across more than 20 software platforms, and many integration and automation decisions are still managed directly by our Founder and CEO. As we work toward our goal of becoming a $10 million company, we need a technical specialist who can connect our systems, eliminate unnecessary manual work, and build a scalable technology foundation.







The AI & Systems Integration Specialist will take ownership of Cooper Roofing's technology stack from end to end. This is not a general virtual assistant position and is not intended for a marketer who has only built a few basic Zapier automations. You will serve as the architect responsible for understanding how our systems, workflows, teams, and data connect. You will audit our existing tools, interview employees about their daily processes, identify inefficiencies, recommend consolidation opportunities, and build reliable integrations using platforms such as Zapier, 
, and n8n. The role reports directly to the Founder and CEO and works closely with the Marketing Strategist, web developer, and employees throughout the company.







Key Responsibilities



Create and maintain a complete inventory of company software, including each tool's purpose, owner, cost, data, and integrations.

Meet with employees across sales, estimating, administration, production, project management, marketing, and leadership to document workflows and pain points.

Recommend which tools should be retained, replaced, consolidated, or eliminated.

Establish and protect a reliable source of truth for customer and job data within JobNimbus, GoHighLevel, or the appropriate system.

Build and maintain integrations using Zapier, 
, n8n, APIs, webhooks, and custom workflows.

Monitor automation health and resolve failed Zaps, scenarios, webhooks, and data transfers before they affect operations.

Develop AI-assisted estimate and proposal drafting workflows based on job information or photographs.

Automate customer follow-up sequences based on JobNimbus stages.

Integrate call transcription and summaries with customer and job records.

Develop lead-scoring systems using historical sales and closing data.

Build AI-assisted review-response workflows that require human approval before publishing.

Automate the creation of advertising and landing-page variations for the Marketing Strategist to test.

Create content-repurposing workflows across multiple formats and platforms.

Develop scheduling-conflict alerts involving crews, weather, and material deliveries.

Automate the organization of crew photographs and documents into the correct job files.

Build material-ordering triggers connected to job stages and supplier processes.

Automate warranty, callback, and service-reminder tracking.

Connect job-completion stages with invoicing and QuickBooks workflows.

Develop alerts for duplicate invoices, unusual transactions, and other accounting anomalies.

Create automated weekly financial summaries using QuickBooks data.

Automate new-hire onboarding, account setup, documentation, and training checklists.

Build an internal knowledge base or SOP assistant that helps employees answer routine questions.

Create dashboards connecting JobNimbus, QuickBooks, advertising spend, leads, and closed revenue.

Develop proactive alerts for changes such as rising cost per lead, declining close rates, or unusual performance.

Manage integration credentials and access through a shared password manager.

Maintain process maps, system documentation, SOPs, and written offboarding procedures.





Qualifications



Previous experience in IT administration, systems administration, technical operations, automation engineering, or systems integration.

Hands-on experience with at least two of the following platforms: Zapier, 
, and n8n.

Strong preference for candidates with practical n8n experience.

Experience administering a CRM rather than simply using one.

Experience with GoHighLevel, JobNimbus, or a comparable CRM is preferred.

Comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, authentication methods, and JSON.

Ability to create custom integrations when a native connector is unavailable.

Experience connecting QuickBooks or another accounting platform with operational systems.

Experience managing or improving a multi-platform technology stack.

Strong documentation habits and the ability to create clear SOPs and process maps.

Excellent written English and the ability to explain technical processes to non-technical employees.

Strong attention to security, credential management, data accuracy, and access controls.

Direct experience using OpenAI, Anthropic, or another large-language-model API is an asset.

Ability to work independently, investigate technical problems, and recommend solutions based on cost, complexity, reliability, and business value.





Pay and Benefits



Full-time independent contractor position.

Base salary: USD $1,000-$1,500 per month, paid bi-weekly, depending on technical experience, systems integration expertise, and demonstrated ability 

Thirteenth-month bonus for candidates based in the Philippines; an equivalent structure may be discussed for candidates located elsewhere.

Direct working relationship with the Founder and CEO.

Significant ownership of the company's technology and automation strategy.

Opportunity to design systems that will support Cooper Roofing's growth.

Exposure to systems across sales, marketing, estimating, production, finance, human resources, and customer service.

Ongoing professional development within a company that values learning and continuous improvement.

Final candidates may be invited to complete a paid technical assessment as part of the hiring process.

Applicants must be able to consistently provide at least three hours of overlap with Vancouver business hours, with five to eight hours being ideal. Because this position will have near-administrator access to important company systems, finalists should also expect comprehensive reference and background checks upon a conditional offer.





Why Cooper Roofing?



At Cooper Roofing, technology is not treated as an afterthought; it is a critical part of how we plan to grow without adding unnecessary complexity and administrative work. You will have the opportunity to build systems with a visible, company-wide impact and solve meaningful operational problems across every department. We value people who take initiative, document their work, continue learning, and challenge inefficient ways of operating. This is a chance to become the trusted technical owner of a growing company's entire digital ecosystem.







Cooper Roofing encourages applications from qualified candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.



PLEASE SEND THE APPLICATION IN THE FOLLOWING LINK: CooperRoofing.discovered.ai/job-details/68615

title: Experienced Amazon Online Arbitrage VA (US Marketplace) — Sourcing Focus
description:
About us



Farol Ventures LLC is a US-registered e-commerce business selling on Amazon. We run a mix of online arbitrage and wholesale. Ownership sits in Europe (CET timezone), so we work asynchronously and value people who can run their own day without hand-holding. You will be required to use a time tracking log for transparency.



We're looking for one experienced sourcing VA to take ownership of our online arbitrage pipeline — not a beginner we train from scratch.



What you'll do:



- Source profitable OA leads from reputable US retail sites

- Validate every lead against our buying criteria before it reaches me: ROI, net margin after all fees, sales velocity, BSR stability, seller count and competition, Amazon-on-listing status

- Screen for restricted brands, gated categories, IP-complaint history, hazmat, meltable and oversize issues — we do not want leads I can't actually list

- Log leads in our Google Sheets tracker with source URL, ASIN, buy cost, expected sell price, all-in FBA fees, ROI %, estimated monthly sales, and screenshots of the Keepa chart

- Track coupon codes, cashback portals, and gift card discounts that improve landed cost



Requirements — please don't apply without these



- Minimum 2 years of hands-on Amazon online arbitrage sourcing for a US seller account (please state which accounts and roughly what monthly sourcing volume)

- Fluent working English, written and spoken

- Expert-level Keepa reading — you should be able to explain to me why a chart is a buy or a pass

- Working knowledge of at least one of SellerAmp SAS

- Solid grasp of the FBA fee structure: referral fee, fulfillment fee, storage, low-inventory fee, returns exposure

- Awareness of brand gating, IP complaints, and what typically triggers a suspension — you are a filter, not just a lead generator

- Comfortable in Google Sheets (filters, basic formulas, clean data entry)

- Reliable daily availability with at least [2-3] hours of overlap with CET

- Your own computer and stable internet



Nice to have



- Experience opening and managing wholesale accounts with US brands and distributors

- Familiarity with prep centers and 3PL workflows

- Experience with ungating and invoice requirements



How we work



- Target: 10 qualified leads per day, minimum 20% ROI and 5$+ net profit per unit after all fees

- Quality over quantity. A short list I can actually buy from beats a long list I have to re-check

- Weekly async check-in; daily lead sheet updates

- Paid via Paypal or bank wiring. Can be bi-weekly or monthly TBD



How to apply



Send a short message that includes:



- How long you've done Amazon OA sourcing, and for what kind of account

- Which sourcing tools you use daily and why you prefer them

- Two sample leads in this format — real ASINs, sourced this month:

-- Source site + URL

-- ASIN + product name

-- Buy cost, sell price, all-in FBA fees, net profit, ROI %

-- One or two sentences on why you'd buy it, referencing the Keepa data

- Your rate expectation and weekly availability in CET



Applications without sample leads won't be reviewed.

title: Operations Assistant
description:
Center Carpentry



Operations Assistant







Location: Remote - Philippines



Schedule: Flexible, with availability for communication and priority tasks between 7:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time







Build the Systems Behind Exceptional Work



Founded in 2018 and based in New Hampshire's Lakes Region, Center Carpentry is a residential construction firm specializing in custom homes, design-driven renovations, and additions. We combine thoughtful planning, building-science expertise, and meticulous craftsmanship to create homes built to last. As we grow, we are strengthening the systems behind our work to deliver an organized, transparent, and professional building experience.







Our Core Values



Integrity - Every interaction should reinforce trust with clients, trade partners, and each other.

Family - We prioritize the well-being of our families and the families we serve.

Service - We are a service company first; construction is the medium we use to serve well.

Quality Craftsmanship - We build carefully, skillfully, and with deep respect for materials and detail.

Resourcefulness - We solve the unexpected with creativity, patience, and skill.

Efficiency - We work smart, stay organized and prepared, and continuously improve our systems.

Center Carpentry is seeking a proactive, technology-oriented Operations Assistant to support company ownership in improving operational systems and administrative processes. This is more than a traditional administrative position. You will manage essential communications and scheduling while helping establish the workflows, procedures, and digital systems that keep the business moving forward.







The right person can take a goal, verbal instruction, or collection of rough notes and determine what needs to happen next. You will bring clarity to scattered information, turn ideas into organized action, and help ownership remain focused on sales, estimating, project management, and building strong client and industry relationships.







Key Responsibilities



Manage executive inboxes, company phone communications, calendars, appointments, and priority lists.

Coordinate virtual meetings, travel arrangements, and other scheduling logistics.

Capture meeting notes and convert discussions into clear, assigned, and tracked action items.

Create, document, maintain, and help enforce internal workflows and Standard Operating Procedures.

Organize company files, project information, and documentation within Google Drive and JobTread.

Draft and format reports, presentations, correspondence, and internal documents.

Help manage employee onboarding, offboarding, and related administrative processes.

Serve as a dependable point of contact for clients, vendors, trade partners, and other external contacts.

Support the flow of information between ownership, team members, vendors, and clients.

Research, evaluate, interview, and assist with onboarding business, design, and trade vendors.

Gather and organize supplier pricing information to support project estimating.

Implement software improvements, automations, and AI-supported workflows.

Monitor priority items and follow up to promote accountability and timely completion.

Assist with basic marketing, social media, website updates, recruiting, and candidate screening.

Research market trends, building-code developments, industry associations, and certifications.

Handle sensitive company, employee, and client information with strict confidentiality.

Qualifications



Previous experience in construction, residential building, remodeling, or a closely related industry.

Exceptional organizational, prioritization, and task-management abilities.

Strong written and verbal communication skills for client, vendor, and internal business communication in English.

Experience supporting an executive, owner, or small-business leadership team.

Advanced proficiency with Google Workspace and digital collaboration tools.

Comfortable learning and working within JobTread or a comparable construction-management platform.

Strong interest in AI, automation, software systems, and process improvement.

Ability to translate verbal direction and rough notes into structured plans and completed work.

Able to work independently, anticipate needs, and identify the next appropriate action.

Highly accurate and detail-oriented when handling data, documentation, and digital files.

Calm, resourceful, and dependable when priorities change or challenges arise.

Available and responsive during agreed-upon hours within the U.S. Eastern Time business day.

Able to exercise excellent judgment, integrity, and discretion with confidential information.

Alignment with Center Carpentry's core values of Integrity, Family, Service, Quality Craftsmanship, Resourcefulness, and Efficiency.

Pay and Benefits



Part-time, 20 hours per week. Independent contractor role.With the option to transition to a full-time position in the future. 

Pay range: $8 - $10

Fully remote position with scheduling flexibility.

Overseas candidates are welcome to apply.

Long-term opportunity with an established and growing residential construction company.

Professional development and support for learning JobTread, AI tools, and new operational systems.

Regular virtual check-ins to maintain clarity, alignment, and manageable priorities.

Opportunity to expand your hours, responsibilities, and influence as the company grows.

Potential advancement into project coordination, systems ownership, or broader operational leadership.

A work environment that supports family, professional growth, and work-life balance.

Why Center Carpentry?



At Center Carpentry, strong systems are essential to delivering quality craftsmanship and exceptional service. You will become a trusted operational partner and help shape how a growing construction company works behind the scenes. This role offers meaningful ownership, continuous learning, and the ability to turn ideas into processes that produce visible results. If you share our values and take pride in creating order, improving systems, and helping others perform at their best, you can build a lasting career here.







Center Carpentry is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants without regard to protected characteristics under applicable law. We believe in treating people with respect, fairness, and care, creating a workplace where everyone feels valued and supported.

We’re looking for a high-level Creative Strategist & Media Buyer with proven experience in eCommerce, DTC, and direct-response advertising.



This role is for someone who can look at the numbers, understand why an ad is winning or losing, and turn those insights into better creatives, stronger campaigns, and increased revenue.



What You’ll Do

Develop high-converting hooks, angles, concepts, scripts, and creative briefs

Analyze Meta Ads performance, creative metrics, and customer data

Identify winning creatives and determine why they work

Diagnose underperforming ads and develop new iterations

Research competitors, market trends, customer pain points, and emerging angles

Develop concepts for UGC, AI ads, video, static images, advertorials, podcasts, and native ads

Create structured creative testing strategies

Work closely with video editors, designers, copywriters, and media buyers

Analyze CPA, ROAS, CTR, CVR, CPM, hold rate, and other key performance metrics

Identify opportunities to improve offers, landing pages, funnels, and customer journeys

Help scale winning creatives and campaigns profitably

Turn performance data into actionable creative strategies

What We’re Looking For

Strong experience in eCommerce / DTC

Proven Meta Ads experience

Strong understanding of direct-response advertising

Experience analyzing creative performance and advertising data

Strong understanding of hooks, angles, offers, customer psychology, and funnels

Experience building and managing creative testing frameworks

Ability to connect media buying data with creative strategy

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Creative thinker who can quickly generate and test new ideas

Comfortable making fast, data-driven decisions

Excellent English communication skills

German or French experience is a plus

This Role Is NOT For Everyone

Data → Insights → Creative Strategy → Testing → Optimization → Scaling

title: Senior QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper — Part-Time
description:
We are looking for an experienced QuickBooks Online bookkeeper to take ownership of the day-to-day accounting and financial reporting for a growing online education business.



This is a part-time, long-term role.



We want someone who can work independently, clean up our books, maintain accurate financial records, and give the founder clear weekly/monthly reporting without needing constant supervision.



Responsibilities



You will own:



* QuickBooks Online setup and maintenance

* Chart of accounts

* Bank reconciliation

* Credit-card reconciliation

* Payment processor reconciliation

* Transaction categorization

* Historical cleanup / catch-up bookkeeping

* Monthly reconciliation and close

* Basic Accounts Receivable tracking

* Basic Accounts Payable tracking

* Refund and chargeback reporting

* P&L

* Balance Sheet

* Cash Flow Statement

* Weekly cash reporting

* Monthly financial reporting



Our business includes:



* High-ticket and low-ticket revenue

* Payment plans

* Multiple payment processors

* Refunds

* Chargebacks/disputes

* Sales commissions

* Contractors

* Advertising spend

* Software expenses



## Required Experience



You should have strong experience with:



* QuickBooks Online

* US-based businesses

* Online / digital businesses

* Bank and credit-card reconciliations

* Payment processor reconciliation

* Catch-up bookkeeping

* Monthly closes

* AR/AP

* Refunds and chargebacks



Experience with multi-currency businesses is a plus.



## What Success Looks Like



Within the first few weeks, you should be able to:



1. Audit our current financial setup.

2. Identify missing information or accounting issues.

3. Clean up historical bookkeeping.

4. Build the correct QuickBooks structure.

5. Reconcile our bank accounts, cards, and payment processors.

6. Establish a repeatable monthly close process.

7. Give the founder simple, accurate financial reports.



We want someone proactive who can tell us what access or information is needed instead of waiting for every task to be assigned.



## Weekly Reporting



We want a simple weekly report covering:



### Cash



* Current bank cash

* Cash collected this week

* Cash collected month-to-date

* Upcoming bills

* Upcoming payroll

* Available operating cash



Business Performance



* Revenue

* Refunds

* Chargebacks

* Net revenue

* COGS

* Operating expenses

* Net profit

* Net margin



### AR



* Outstanding receivables

* Failed payments

* Amount recovered



AP



* Bills due within 7 days

* Bills due within 30 days



## Monthly Reporting



Every month we expect:



* P&L

* Balance Sheet

* Cash Flow Statement

* AR aging

* AP aging

* Bank reconciliations

* Refund/chargeback report

* Clean monthly close



## Compensation



$500–$700 USD/month to start, depending on experience.



This is a part-time, long-term position.



We will begin with a paid 30-day trial.



There is room for increased compensation as the business grows and you take on more responsibility.



## Important



You will receive the appropriate accounting and read-only permissions where possible.



You will not initially be responsible for independently moving company money or making major financial decisions.



Your role is primarily:



Maintain accurate books → reconcile everything → report the numbers → flag problems.



## How to Apply



:







Subject:



Senior Bookkeeper — [Your Name]



Please include:



* How many years you have worked as a bookkeeper

* Your QuickBooks Online experience

* Examples of online businesses you have worked with

* Experience reconciling payment processors

* Experience with catch-up bookkeeping

* Experience with AR/AP

* Your current availability

* Your expected monthly compensation



Also answer:



If you inherited messy books from an online business with multiple payment processors, refunds, chargebacks, payment plans, bank accounts, and credit cards, what would your first 5 steps be?



Please do not send a generic application.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership, identify problems, and keep our accounting organized without constant hand-holding.

title: SENIOR AI VIDEO EDITOR — ECOM DIRECT RESPONSE (META)

→ ~80% in our proven house style: you'll study our winners library and match the editing DNA that's already converting for us

→ ~20% in YOUR style: Provide dedicated batches where you bring your own editing style to show your creativity and widen the creative diversity of our weekly testing

→Monthly Base increasing related to your batch capacity (25 batches per week / 40 batches per week / + XYZ Batches per week = Base much more higher

title: Junior Operations Coordinator
description:
Department: Operations

Reports To: Operations Specialist

Employment Type: Full
 Remote



Position Overview

We are seeking a Junior Operations Coordinator to provide day-to-day operational support across our restaurant locations.

This is an entry-level operations support role focused on accurate data entry, recurring operational checks, reporting support, store follow-up, and task tracking.

The Junior Operations Coordinator will work closely with the Operations Specialist and will be responsible for completing established daily and weekly processes, maintaining accurate operational records, identifying missing or inconsistent information, and escalating issues that require further review.

This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working with spreadsheets and multiple systems, and able to consistently follow established processes.



Key Responsibilities

Daily Operational Monitoring

Check daily completion of required operational reports and submissions from restaurant locations.

Monitor Daily Sales Summary (DSS) completion and send reminders to locations with missing submissions.

Monitor Tip Automation completion and follow up on incomplete items.

Check deposit entries and assist with daily deposit reconciliation.

Identify missing, incomplete, or unusual entries and escalate exceptions to the Operations Specialist.

Maintain daily operational trackers and status reports.

Process store orders through the ordering platform, monitor delivery completion, and report any feedback, issues, or missing items.

Reporting & Data Support

Enter, update, organize, and validate operational data across spreadsheets and internal systems.

Assist with Sales, Labor, and Inventory reporting.

Compile information from multiple restaurant locations into standardized reports.

Maintain accurate records and trackers.

Perform basic data checks to identify missing or inconsistent information.

Prepare recurring reports and summaries using established templates.

Keep operational documentation organized and up to date.

Staffing & Scheduling Support

Assist with general schedule-related tasks across restaurant locations.

Collect and organize staffing and scheduling information as needed.

Review schedules for completeness and flag any potential concerns.

Track observations and prepare summaries for review by the Operations Specialist.

Communicate with locations when additional information or clarification is required.

 

Required Skills & Qualifications

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

Comfortable performing repetitive and process-driven tasks consistently.

Proficient in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

Comfortable working with multiple systems, spreadsheets, and online platforms.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Able to communicate professionally with restaurant employees and managers.

Able to follow SOPs and established procedures.

Comfortable identifying missing or inconsistent information.

Reliable with daily deadlines and recurring responsibilities.

Able to work independently while knowing when to escalate an issue.



Preferred Qualifications

1+ year of experience in operations, administration, data entry, reporting, customer service, logistics, or a similar support role.

Experience working with spreadsheets and operational reports.

Experience supporting multiple locations, teams, customers, or accounts.

Restaurant, hospitality, food service, retail, or multi-location business experience is a plus.

Familiarity with POS, delivery platforms, scheduling systems, or restaurant management systems is a plus.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Junior Operations Coordinator will:

Complete recurring daily tasks accurately and on time.

Keep trackers and reports current.

Minimize data-entry and reporting errors.

Follow up consistently on missing information.

Identify exceptions before they become larger operational problems.

Escalate issues appropriately instead of allowing them to remain unresolved.

Become increasingly independent in managing recurring workflows.

Reduce the amount of repetitive monitoring and follow-up required from the Operations Specialist.



Growth Opportunity

This role is designed as an entry point into restaurant operations. As the employee develops stronger analytical, reporting, and operational skills, responsibilities may expand into more advanced reporting, schedule analysis, inventory and labor analysis, and broader operational coordination.

title: Senior Technical Implementation VA / AI Automation Specialist
description:
Senior Technical Implementation VA / AIAutomation Specialist



About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Technical Implementation VA / AI Automation Specialist to serve as a

primary hands-on technical resource for ReThink/AIA.

This is a senior-level implementation role for someone who can take a real business problem, understand

the underlying requirements, design the appropriate technical solution, and independently build, test,

deploy, troubleshoot, and document it.

You should be comfortable speaking with business owners and executives, asking the right questions,

challenging unclear requirements, and translating business objectives into reliable automation and AI

systems.



This is not a task-based VA role. We are looking for someone who can operate as a technical solutions

partner with minimal supervision and eventually help ReThink build repeatable technical fulfillment systems

as the client base grows.



Compensation

Starting at $15/hour, with the intention to transition to a monthly retainer based on experience, technical

capability, and performance.



Key Responsibilities



Serve as the primary hands-on technical implementation resource for Kyler/ReThink.

Participate in client discovery calls when technical expertise is required.

Analyze business processes, workflows, data requirements, integrations, and desired outcomes to

properly scope projects.



Ask intelligent and detailed questions before recommending or building a solution.

Translate business problems into appropriate technical architecture, workflows, integrations, and

implementation plans.



Build and deploy AI agents, workflow automations, CRM systems, lead-management processes,

appointment-setting workflows, sales automation, dashboards, and related solutions.

Configure and integrate APIs, webhooks, third-party SaaS platforms, databases, CRM systems, and

automation tools.

Build and maintain solutions using platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, GoHighLevel, or

comparable technologies.



Determine where AI and automation should—and should not—be used within a business process.

Thoroughly test implementations before client deployment.



Diagnose and resolve broken automations, API failures, integration issues, data-flow problems, CRM

configuration issues, and edge cases.

Maintain and optimize deployed systems after launch.

Document technical architecture, workflows, access requirements, configurations, SOPs, and client

handoffs.



Communicate project status, blockers, dependencies, risks, and next steps clearly.

Work alongside with the team, and other fulfillment resources as required.

Identify when a requested solution is technically impractical, unnecessarily complex, or better solved

through an alternative approach.



Help establish reusable technical SOPs, templates, workflows, and fulfillment standards that can

improve implementation efficiency as ReThink grows.

Own implementations from discovery through scoping, build, testing, deployment,

documentation, and ongoing optimization.



Required Qualifications & Skills

Senior Technical Implementation Experience

Senior-level, hands-on experience building and implementing AI automation systems for real

businesses and end clients.

Proven ability to independently take ownership of technical projects from requirements gathering

through deployment.

Experience working directly with clients or stakeholders to understand business requirements and

translate them into technical solutions.



Automation & CRM

Strong working knowledge of:

CRM systems

Workflow automation

AI agents

API and webhook integrations

Lead capture and management

Appointment booking

Sales pipelines

 and SMS automation

Reporting and dashboards

Advanced proficiency with tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier, GoHighLevel, or comparable platforms.

Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and AIA's existing technology stack.



AI & Technical Architecture

Strong understanding of LLM and AI-agent implementation.

Ability to determine when AI adds meaningful value and when a traditional automation or non-AI

solution is more appropriate.

Ability to design technical architecture based on the actual business requirement rather than simply

following predefined workflows.

Strong troubleshooting and debugging capabilities across automation platforms, APIs, CRMs,

integrations, and data flows.



Client Communication



Comfortable joining discovery and implementation calls with business owners, executives, and other

nontechnical stakeholders.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong business acumen and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to nontechnical clients.

Able to ask thoughtful questions, identify missing information, clarify requirements, and manage

expectations professionally.



Autonomy & Ownership



Highly autonomous and capable of working with minimal technical oversight.

Should not require detailed SOPs or step-by-step instructions for every assignment.

Able to identify dependencies, technical risks, access requirements, and potential blockers before

development begins.

Comfortable taking ownership when requirements are ambiguous and proactively determining the

next steps.

Strong documentation habits and attention to detail.



Preferred Qualifications

The following are highly valued but not required:

Experience working directly with AI automation agencies or consulting businesses.

Experience delivering automation solutions across multiple end-client environments.

Experience designing and deploying custom AI agents.

Experience with:

AI voice systems

Conversational AI

Inbound/outbound lead qualification

AI appointment setters

Sales automation

Familiarity with SaaS and white-label environments.

Experience working with agency CRM infrastructure.

Experience supporting both internal agency infrastructure and external client fulfillment.

Familiarity with OpenAI/LLM APIs, vector databases, RAG, structured prompting, and advanced

agentic workflows.

Previous experience as a Technical Solutions Consultant, Implementation Manager, Technical

Lead, or similar role, rather than exclusively working as a task-based VA.

Experience creating technical SOPs, reusable templates, and standardized fulfillment systems.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured by:



Technical projects delivered accurately and within agreed timelines.

Ability to independently move projects through discovery ? scope ? build ? test ? launch.

Minimal technical oversight required from Kyler or the AIA team.

Quality, reliability, and scalability of automations and AI solutions deployed.

Speed and accuracy when diagnosing and resolving technical issues.

Strong performance during client-facing discovery and implementation calls.

Ability to identify requirements and dependencies upfront, reducing rework.

Clear and proactive communication regarding project status, blockers, risks, dependencies, and next

steps.

Quality of technical documentation and client handoffs.

Development of reusable systems, templates, SOPs, and processes that improve fulfillment

efficiency.

Ability to identify better or simpler technical approaches when appropriate.



What Success Looks Like

You should be someone who can move beyond simply executing instructions and instead operate as a 

technical problem-solver and implementation partner.

title: Amazon PPC / Advertising Specialist
description:
Amazon PPC Specialist - Pax Distribution



We manage Amazon end-to-end for premium brands. You'd run the ad accounts day to day. Build the campaigns, read the data, kill what's not working, double down on what is.



This isn't a set-it-and-forget-it seat. We don't manage everything to one ACoS number and call it a day. Every campaign has a job, and the job d
 the metric. A rank-building campaign gets judged differently than a profitability one. If that made sense to you, keep reading. If it didn't, this isn't your role.



What you'd actually do





Build and manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display across several brands

Structure campaigns so our own products don't bid against each other



Own the negative keyword work. This is where most people get lazy and it's where accounts quietly leak money

Read Search Query Performance and Brand Analytics, and tell me which terms we can actually win and which we can't

Know when to stop spending, not just when to spend



You're a fit if



You think in terms of what a campaign is for, not just its ACoS

You'll tell me a keyword isn't worth it even when it looks good on paper

You get that sometimes the fix is the reviews or the listing, not more ad spend

You treat a budget as a ceiling, not a quota to hit



You're not a fit if



You manage everything to one blended ACoS target

You think more spend is always the answer

You need to be told what to do every day

You can't explain why you made a bid change

description:
Project Manager (Remote)



Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Opportunity



Stone Creation is a rapidly growing luxury stone fabrication and installation company based in Irvine, California. We specialize in high-end residential and commercial projects, including quartz, porcelain, natural stone, fireplaces, wall cladding, and custom architectural stonework.



We are looking for an exceptional Project Manager who will oversee projects from contract through final installation while ensuring every customer receives an outstanding experience.

This is not a position for someone who waits to be told what to do. We are looking for a proactive, organized, detail-oriented individual who takes ownership of their work, communicates exceptionally well, and enjoys solving problems before they happen.

____



About You

You are someone who:

- Takes ownership of every project.

- Is highly organized and detail-oriented.

- Communicates professionally and confidently with customers and tea
mbers.

- Thrives in a fast-paced environment.

- Learns new software and processes quickly.

- Can prioritize multiple projects without missing deadlines.

- Is resourceful, dependable, and accountable.

- Continuously looks for ways to improve systems and processes.

Responsibilities

As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for coordinating projects from the time the contract is signed until the project is successfully completed.

Responsibilities include:

- Managing multiple projects simultaneously.

- Coordinating project schedules with customers and field personnel.

- Scheduling templating, fabrication, deliveries, and installations.

- Communicating with customers throughout every stage of the project.

- Coordinating with sales, templators, fabricators, installers, and subcontractors.

- Reviewing project documentation for accuracy before production.

- Following up on customer approvals and outstanding items.

- Tracking project progress daily and ensuring deadlines are met.

- Identifying scheduling conflicts and resolving issues proactively.

- Maintaining accurate project notes and documentation.

- Ensuring all projects follow Stone Creation's internal procedures and quality standards.

- Providing exceptional customer service from start to finish.

____



Qualifications

Required

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Outstanding organizational and time management skills.

- Strong customer service and communication skills.

- Ability to multitask and manage multiple deadlines.

- Strong problem-solving skills.

-- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Highly proficient with computers and learning new software.

____



Preferred

- Experience in the stone, tile, cabinetry, kitchen & bath, construction, or remodeling industry.

- Previous experience managing residential construction or custom fabrication projects.

- Software Experience

- Experience with any of the following is a plus:

- EasedEdge (preferred)

- Slack

- Microsoft Office

- Google Workspace

- Zoom



Don't worry if you haven't used every program—we're looking for someone who learns quickly.

____



What Success Looks Like

Our ideal Project Manager:

- Keeps projects moving without being reminded.

-Anticipates problems before they affect the customer.

-Communicates proactively with customers and the internal team.

- Maintains accurate schedules and documentation.

- Takes pride in delivering an exceptional customer experience.

- Helps improve our processes as the company continues to grow.

____



What We Offer

- Full-time, long-term employment.

- Opportunity for growth within a rapidly expanding company.

- Performance-based raises.

- Paid time off.

- Ongoing training and development.

A supportive team environment where your ideas and contributions matter.

We are building a team for the long term and are looking for someone who wants to grow with us.

____



How to Apply

Please submit:

- Your resume.

- A short introduction about yourself.

- Why you believe you would be a great fit for this role.

- A brief description of the most challenging project you've managed and how you successfully handled it.

Important: To show that you pay attention to detail, please include the words "Stone PM Ready" as the first line of your application.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



We look forward to welcoming an exceptional Project Manager to the Stone Creation team.

title: Multi-Brand DTC E-commerce (China Sourcing + Amazon + Shopify)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are a group of direct-to-consumer ecommerce brands selling physical

products (kits, apparel and accessories, supplements) across Shopify

and Amazon US. Products are manufactured in China and the US and distributed through

warehouses in China, the US and Europe.

Supply chain is currently being handled internally alongside other work,

and it has become the bottleneck. This hire takes it over. Within 60 days

you should own supplier communication, inventory planning and warehouse

planning completely.

This is not a coordinator or data-entry role. You make decisions and you

are judged on results.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

1. INVENTORY FORECASTING AND REPLENISHMENT

   Across every brand and channel (Shopify plus Amazon FBA and AWD).

   No stockouts on winners, no cash locked in dead stock.

2. CHINA FACTORY SOURCING AND NEGOTIATION

   You inherit our existing factory relationships, nurture them, run

   sample rounds, and hunt better suppliers on price, quality and lead

   time.

3. PACKAGING AND PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

   Write briefs for our in-house designers (boxes, inserts, kits,

   bundles), manage dielines and print specs with factories, approve

   samples.

4. AMAZON PLANNING

   Shipment plans, carton and prep compliance, kit and bundle size rules,

   AWD to FBA replenishment, and resolving Seller Central or warehouse

   restrictions before they cost us money.

5. INTERNATIONAL WAREHOUSE PLANNING

   3PL contracts, capacity and stock allocation across China, the US and

   Europe. Freight forwarding (ocean and air), customs paperwork, landed

   cost tracking.

6. COST REDUCTION

   Unit cost, packaging cost, freight, storage and fulfilment fees. You

   are measured on landed cost per unit and on cash tied up in inventory.

7. PRODUCT LIFECYCLE

   Flag slow movers, plan run-outs, roll them into bundles or mystery

   boxes, keep the catalog clean.

REQUIREMENTS

- 5+ years in ecommerce or DTC supply chain, procurement or logistics.

  Multi-brand or portfolio experience is a strong plus.

- Proven China factory sourcing and negotiation. You have personally

  negotiated unit prices, MOQs and lead times, and won.

- Hands-on Amazon FBA experience: shipment plans, prep and labeling

  requirements, AWD, and dealing with Seller Central restrictions.

- Freight and import knowledge: ocean and air freight, incoterms, customs

  documents, landed cost.

- Strong inventory forecasting. You build and maintain your own models in

  Google Sheets or Excel: sales velocity, lead time, safety stock,

  reorder points.

- Shopify inventory management.

- Excellent written and spoken English. You will be on calls with Chinese

  factories, US warehouses and European suppliers.

- Deadline discipline. We run on Asana. Tasks are not delivered late. If

  something will slip, you flag it BEFORE the due date, not after.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience at an 8 or 9 figure ecommerce brand.

- Packaging design or print production background.

- Setting up a new 3PL or warehouse from scratch.

- Supplement or regulated product experience.

WHAT WE OFFER

- 3500 USD per month, long term, full time.

- Real ownership. You are the decision maker on supply chain, not a

  middleman passing messages.

- Direct access to the decision makers. No layers, no politics.

- Growth. As the group adds brands, this role grows into Head of Supply

  Chain.

HOW TO APPLY

Generic applications are deleted. Answer all six points or do not apply.

1. Put the word ORANGE at the very top of your message so we know you

   read this post.

2. A supplier negotiation you personally ran. Give the product, the

   starting price, the final price, and exactly how you got there.

3. How you d
 reorder quantity and timing for a SKU. Walk us through

   the actual numbers you look at.

4. One time inventory or a shipment went wrong on your watch. What

   happened, and what you changed so it did not happen again.

5. Your Amazon FBA experience in three lines: what you shipped, how

   often, what problems you solved.

6. Your available working hours in GMT+2.

title: Technical Content Producer (Design, Motion & Video)
description:
Built Mighty is a fast-growing WooCommerce and e-commerce agency that builds powerful, custom digital commerce solutions for ambitious brands. We combine deep technical expertise with strategic thinking to deliver results our clients love.



We're scaling our content output and need someone who can actually build it; design the page in Figma, cut the video, animate the graphic, and ship it across our site, LinkedIn, and YouTube.



Role Overview



This is a hands-on production role, not a writing role. You'll take a project win, a technical concept, or a client story and turn it into finished assets: designed website pages, branded graphics, motion pieces, and edited video.



Think of yourself as the person who owns everything between "here's the story" and "it's live and it looks great." You'll work directly with our developers, project managers, and leadership to help bring these stories to life.



Key Responsibilities



Design & Web Content



Design website pages, landing pages, and case study layouts in Figma, components, auto-layout, responsive breakpoints, and clean handoff to our dev team.

Build and maintain a reusable component and template library so we stop designing the same block twice.

Produce supporting graphics: diagrams, before/after visuals, data callouts, social cards, thumbnails.

Publish or assist in publishing finished pages in WordPress, keeping design intent intact.



Motion & Video



Create motion graphics - animated explainers, UI walkthroughs, kinetic type, logo stings, Lottie/After Effects assets for the site.

Edit short-form and long-form video: screen recordings, Zoom interviews, on-camera segments. Handle color, audio cleanup, captions, lower thirds, and B-roll.

Own video and YouTube production end to end: editing, thumbnails, titles, chapters, descriptions, and end screens. This is a new venture and we're starting from zero.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Duties & Responsibilities

Role Summary

The Full Stack Developer reviews, repairs, and maintains the web application our team and our clients

rely on every day. The role begins with a focused review — a clear, prioritized picture of what is broken,

risky, or slow — and then works through that list with us, most important first. Our app connects to our

clients' QuickBooks Online accounts and turns their accounting data into CFO-level reports and

dashboards, so accuracy, reliability, and security are the heart of the job.

Application Review & Assessment

- Give honest estimates of effort so leaders can d
 what to tackle first.



Bug Fixes & Application Maintenance



- Fix bugs across the app — data accuracy, syncing, and the user interface. Improve the reliability and accuracy of the QuickBooks Online data sync.



- Harden security and improve performance.



- Keep the app stable and deployable while changes are being made.



Testing & Documentation



- Write and maintain automated end-to-end tests (Playwright) so fixes stay fixed.



- Document what changed and why, so the work is easy to pick up later.



Maintain clear technical notes and documentation.



 



Technical Environment Backend:



Python 3.11, FastAPI, raw SQL Database: PostgreSQL Frontend: one large single-file vanilla JavaScript app (no framework, no build step) Integrations: QuickBooks Online API (OAuth2) Hosting / deploy: Railway (push to GitHub = deploy) Testing: Playwright (end-to-end)

I use Asana for project management and that's where I'll assign tasks, share deadlines, and keep projects organized.
