Collaborate with validation, operations, and development teams to resolve cross-functional issues



Contribute to our knowledge base by identifying gaps and drafting clear, technical FAQs and troubleshooting guides



Continuous Learning & Skill Development (This is where you separate yourself from candidates just looking for any support job)



Proactively master SSL 's expanding product portfolio and stay current with PKI industry standards



Develop deep technical knowledge of networking fundamentals (DNS, HTTPS, TLS protocols, certificate chains, firewalls, port configurations)



Build expertise in public key infrastructure concepts: certificate authorities, validation types, trust chains, revocation (CRL/OCSP), cryptographic algorithms



Participate actively in training sessions, team meetings, and feedback discussions, applying insights to improve your performance



Quality & Performance Excellence



Maintain professional, empathetic communication that adapts to technical and non-technical audiences



Follow SLAs and best practices for ticket handling, prioritization, and resolution confirmation



Contribute customer feedback and identify recurring technical challenges that drive process improvements



Demonstrate problem-solving initiative and analytical thinking before escalating issues



What We're Looking For



Required Qualifications



Growth mindset: You're intellectually curious, embrace challenges, and see feedback as fuel for improvement



Technical aptitude: Comfortable learning complex technical concepts; prior experience with web technologies, DNS, or basic networking is a plus



Communication excellence: Outstanding written and verbal skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly



Schedule flexibility: Available for EU/Asia or Americas/EU shift coverage



Self-motivation: Thrives in remote environments with minimal supervision



Customer-first attitude: Patient, adaptable, and genuinely invested in customer success



Ideal Candidate Profile



2-3 years customer support experience, preferably in SaaS, cybersecurity, or technical environments



Familiarity with SSL/TLS certificates, PKI, or information security concepts



Experience with ticketing systems (Intercom, Zendesk, etc.)



Basic understanding of web servers, certificate installation, or system administration



Passion for cybersecurity and digital trust technologies



Track record of exceeding performance metrics and receiving positive customer feedback



Bonus Points



Exposure to code signing, document signing, or digital certificate technologies



Understanding of C2PA (Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity) or content authentication



Experience supporting B2B/enterprise customers



Multilingual capabilities



We're looking for someone who sees this role as the beginning of a cybersecurity career, not just another support job.



About SSL



SSL  is a leading certificate authority providing digital certificates and PKI solutions that power trust and security for businesses globally. Our product portfolio includes SSL/TLS certificates, code signing certificates (including EV code signing with hardware tokens), document signing solutions, S/MIME
 certificates, C2PA content credentials for media authenticity, and client authentication certificates.



To Apply: Please submit your resume along with a brief statement (3-4 sentences) explaining why you're seeking a growth-oriented Tier 1 role and what specific aspects of SSL's products or PKI technology interest you.

description:

title: Merchant Success Specialist
description:
ABOUT US



Stock2Cash is an Australian, technology-driven eCommerce business helping retailers, brands, wholesalers, and other businesses unlock value from inventory by connecting products with online customers.



As we continue to grow, we are building a stronger eCommerce Operations team to support the increasing number of merchants joining the Stock2Cash platform.



We are looking for a Merchant Success Specialist who can help our merchants achieve better outcomes, identify issues and opportunities, and maintain strong, productive relationships throughout their time with Stock2Cash.



ABOUT THE ROLE



The Merchant Success Specialist will be responsible for helping merchants perform, improve, and succeed after they become operational with Stock2Cash.



You will work with merchants and internal teams to understand merchant performance, identify problems, investigate their causes, coordinate appropriate actions, and follow through to ensure meaningful outcomes.



This role requires someone who can work with people, performance information, data, systems, and competing priorities while maintaining a strong focus on merchant outcomes.



You will frequently encounter situations where the problem is not immediately obvious.



We are therefore looking for someone who does not simply react to what a merchant tells them, but can:

Understand → Analyze → Identify → Recommend → Coordinate → Follow Through → Verify



We will provide the objectives, resources, and support required to perform the role.



You will be expected to use your own judgment and experience to determine how to achieve the required outcome.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your responsibilities will include:



- Build and maintain productive relationships with assigned merchants.

- Monitor merchant activity and performance.

- Review relevant sales, product, inventory, marketplace, and operational information.

- Identify performance issues, risks, and opportunities.

- Investigate problems and determine what may be contributing to them.

- Distinguish between symptoms and underlying issues.

- Communicate relevant findings and recommendations to merchants and internal teams.

- Coordinate with appropriate operational teams to address identified issues.

- Follow up on actions and outstanding matters.

- Verify whether completed actions have produced the intended result.

- Monitor merchant progress following operational changes or interventions.

- Identify merchants that may require additional attention.

- Recognize potential retention risks and communicate them appropriately.

- Identify potential growth and improvement opportunities.

- Help merchants understand relevant issues and recommended actions.

- Maintain accurate merchant records and relevant performance information.

- Keep appropriate internal stakeholders informed of significant merchant concerns, risks, and opportunities.

- Take ownership of assigned merchant matters from identification through outcome.

- Contribute ideas that may improve merchant performance, experience, retention, and operational efficiency.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who can demonstrate real experience, not simply claim that they are customer-focused, analytical, proactive, or hardworking.



You should be someone who:



- Can look at performance information and identify meaningful changes, patterns, problems, or opportunities. You do not need to be a data scientist. You do need to be comfortable asking: "What is the data telling me?"

- When you identify a merchant issue, you do not simply pass it to another person and forget about it. You remain aware of the outcome and follow through until the matter is resolved or properly escalated.

- Can communicate with merchants and internal teams clearly and professionally, including when discussing problems, delays, performance concerns, or recommended actions.

- Understands that merchant performance is connected to business outcomes.

- Are interested not only in solving problems, but also in identifying opportunities to improve performance and create additional value.

- Are comfortable receiving an objective without requiring someone to explain every individual step.

- Should know when additional information, clarification, assistance, or escalation is required.

- Understands that identifying a problem is not the same as solving it. You remain involved until there is a meaningful outcome.



MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years of relevant professional experience in eCommerce, account management, customer success, merchant success, client management, operations, sales support, or a related field.

- Experience working directly with customers, clients, merchants, suppliers, or business partners.

- Strong written and verbal English communication.

- Strong relationship-management skills.

- Strong organizational skills.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.

- Comfortable working with business or performance data.

- Strong follow-up skills.

- Ability to manage multiple merchants, priorities, and deadlines.

- Ability to work independently.

- Demonstrated ability to take ownership of assigned responsibilities.

- Ability to communicate problems and recommendations clearly.

- Ability to work effectively with multiple internal teams.



EXPERIENCE THAT WOULD BE AN ADVANTAGE



The following experience would be advantageous:

- eCommerce operations;

- Merchant success;

- Customer success;

- Account management;

- Client relationship management;

- Marketplace operations;

- Sales or business development;

- Product or inventory management;

- Performance analysis;

- Commercial account management;

- CRM systems;

- Reporting and dashboard tools;

- Project or task management systems;

- Working with Australian businesses or customers.



These are advantages, not substitutes for strong judgment, communication, analytical ability, and ownership.

What matters to us is whether you have the experience and ability to understand a merchant's situation, analyze what is happening, identify what needs attention, communicate effectively, and take action toward a measurable outcome. This distinction is intentional and follows our recruitment philosophy.



HOW TO APPLY?



To apply, please provide the following:

1. Your resume — this must be provided as a public, downloadable link.

2. A snapshot of your qualification and relevant experience



Answer the following questions:



1. Tell us about a time when you were responsible for the success or ongoing performance of a client, customer, merchant, account, or business relationship. What was your responsibility, what did you do, and what was the outcome?

2. Tell us about a time when you identified a problem or decline in performance that was not immediately obvious. How did you identify it, how did you investigate it, and what did you do about it?

3. Tell us about a time when you identified an opportunity to improve a client's, customer's, or business partner's results. How did you identify the opportunity, what action did you take, and what was the result?

4. Tell us about a time when you identified an issue that required another person or department to take action. How did you communicate the issue, how did you ensure it was followed through, and what was the final outcome?



NOTE: Please answer based on your actual experience. We are interested in what you have actually done, not what you think we want to hear. There is no requirement to use specific terminology or provide the "perfect" answer.



At the end of your application, please include the exact phrase: "Push Boundaries" This confirms that you have read the full job post and application requirements. Applications that do not follow the application instructions may not be considered.



OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS



Our recruitment process consists of four stages. If you are successful in this first stage, you will be invited to complete a written assessment. If you are not successful, you will receive a decline notification.



Each stage is designed to help us better understand your experience, approach, and suitability for the role as we progress through the process.



READY TO APPLY?



If you believe your experience and approach are a strong match for the role, we would like to hear from you. Please submit your application with the information requested above.

title: Sales Coordinator — Garage Solutions (Remote)
description:
Full-time · Remote (Philippines) · US business hours · $650 → $2,000+/mo on a published ladder



Read this entire post before applying. The application instructions are specific. Applications that don't follow them are deleted without being read. That isn't us being difficult — following written instructions carefully is the job.





The short version:

Open Door Garage helps people transform one of the most overlooked spaces in their home: the garage. Car lifts, flooring, cabinets, storage, lighting, full garage builds.



Our customers are spending real money on something they have never bought before. They don't know what fits, what's worth it, how shipping works, or who can install it. They are afraid of making an expensive mistake.



Your job is to move them from uncertainty to confidence.



We are hiring one person. We would rather leave the seat empty another month than fill it with the wrong person.





This job is not:

- Not high-volume, low-ticket sales. You will not be making 80 dials a day chasing $40 orders.

- Not cold calling. Every person you speak with came to us. They already have a project and they are already looking.

- Not scripted. There is no pitch to memorize and no rebuttal sheet. Real questions, real answers, real recommendations.

- Not pressure selling. If a product isn't right for someone's space, vehicle, or budget, we tell them. You will never be pushed to close something that isn't right for the customer.



What it actually is:

Longer-form, consultative guidance.



Someone is planning a project — a four-post lift, an epoxy floor, a full cabinet system, sometimes an entire garage build. They have a specific space, specific vehicles, a budget, and a picture in their head. Your job is to understand all of that before recommending anything.



These conversations often run across days or weeks. You'll talk to the same person more than once. You'll chase down an answer from a supplier, get an installer quote, revise a recommendation when you learn something new about their space. Purchases range from a $100 accessory to a $20,000 garage build, and the bigger ones are rarely d
 in a single call.





Why this post is different from the other 200 you're scrolling past:

Most remote sales jobs hand you a vague title, a flat salary, and no idea how to get ahead. "Growth opportunities" that never materialize.



We built a four-stage ladder. We wrote down exactly what each stage owns, exactly what you have to demonstrate to move up, and exactly what each one pays. It's a real internal document, and you'll be trained against it from week one.



Stage 0 — Training · maximum 6 weeks · $650/mo Learn the products, the tools, the process. Shadow real customer conversations. This stage is time-boxed: after six weeks you move to Stage 1 pay, provided you're staying.



Stage 1 — Foundation · $850/mo You own first contact. Answer and return inbound calls, handle live chat, run discovery, keep every opportunity organized, follow up on open quotes using approved templates. You're not yet quoting or recommending independently — you're becoming the reliable front door.



Stage 2 — Coordinator · $1,050/mo + $250 team bonus in any month company net profit exceeds $5,000 You own the repeatable parts of the sale. Discovery, routine product recommendations within approved guidance, standard quotes, installer sourcing, follow-up, straightforward closes, and clean handoffs.



Stage 3 — Advisor · $1,250/mo + 5% of net profit on sales you own or close + $250 team bonus You independently own the majority of qualified opportunities from first contact through handoff. Realistic total at this stage: $1,800–$2,200/mo.



Progression is earned through demonstrated capability, not time served. If you're good, you move quickly. We have zero interest in holding someone at $850 who's ready for $1,050. The commission at Stage 3 is uncapped — the better you sell, the more you make, with no argument required.





What you'll actually do:

- Answer, return, and place calls with prospective customers

- Triage incoming calls and route the ones that aren't sales to the right place

- Monitor and respond to website live chat

- Run discovery — the space, the vehicles, the timeline, the budget, what they're actually trying to accomplish

- Keep every active opportunity current in HubSpot with a clear next step

- Follow up on open quotes on schedule, in a way that reads human rather than automated

- Gather what's needed to source and price installers

- Study our products, brands, and the questions customers ask most





The hardest requirement, stated plainly:

Clear, easy-to-understand spoken English

This is the requirement most applicants will not meet, so we'd rather be upfront than waste your time.



You'll spend your day on the phone with American homeowners and contractors. The standard is simple, and it's about the customer rather than about you: they should never have to concentrate to understand you, and never have to ask you to repeat yourself. When a customer has to work to follow what you're saying, they hear friction — and on a purchase they're already nervous about, friction reads as risk.



We are not asking you to sound American. What matters is that you are easy to listen to: clear, natural, well-paced, and warm.



Written English matters just as much. You'll be writing quotes, follow-ups, and explanations that need to read clearly and sound like a real person.



We hired for this role once before and did not screen this closely enough. We're not repeating that. That's why a voice recording is required with your application, and why it's the first thing we review.





Everything else we need:

- Real sales or customer-facing experience. You've talked to actual customers, handled objections, and lost deals you learned something from.

- Genuinely organized. You track what you owe people and follow through without being reminded. Nothing falls through.

- Comfortable saying "I don't know — let me find out." We would much rather you check than guess. Never trade accuracy for the appearance of expertise.

- Reliable during your coverage window. A customer should never wonder whether their message disappeared.

- Coachable. You'll get direct feedback. We fix systems rather than blame people — but you have to be willing to hear it and adjust.

- Stable internet, a quiet place to take calls, and a headset that doesn't make you sound like you're in a tunnel.



Nice to have — not required

- Experience in garage, home improvement, construction, automotive, or building products

- Experience in Shopify and HubSpot or any real CRM

- eCommerce background

- Experience selling considered, higher-ticket purchases rather than impulse buys



If you have industry experience, say so — it's a real advantage and we'll weigh it. But we'd rather hire an excellent communicator with strong judgment and teach them garages than hire someone who knows garages and can't build trust on a phone call. We don't need you to know everything. We need you to be resourceful, curious, and willing to find the right answer.





Who this is for:

- You've sold something real, to real people, and can tell us what you learned from a deal you lost

- You'd rather help someone buy the right thing than push them toward the expensive thing

- You enjoy the puzzle of understanding a project before solving it

- You want a ladder with numbers on it, not a job with a ceiling nobody will name



Who this is not for:

- Anyone who wants a fixed, unchanging list of tasks

- Anyone who needs to be told what to do next every single day

- Anyone planning to run this alongside two other clients — this is a full-time seat

- Anyone who thinks "sales" means reading a script and pressuring people





What we're building, and what we expect:

Open Door Garage is not trying to be the cheapest place to buy garage products, and we're not a transactional catalog. The whole business rests on one idea:



Every interaction should leave the customer more confident than they were before they found us.



A phone call should increase confidence. A quote should increase confidence. A follow-up should increase confidence. In this role, those three are yours.



That leads to a few things we actually believe and act on:



- We earn confidence before we earn revenue. A sale isn't a win if the customer feels confused, pressured, or set up for disappointment. Sometimes that means slowing down, or walking away from a bad-fit sale.

- We improve the system instead of blaming the person. When something goes wrong we look for the gap — was the expectation unclear? Was the process missing? Accountability matters, but blame rarely improves the future. Better systems do.

- We build capability, not dependency. Every process, template, and piece of training should make the company stronger and make you more capable.

- Growth is contagious here. We want this to be a place where people become more capable, more confident, and more motivated to improve their work and their lives.



When someone finishes working with us, we want them to think: They made this easier. They helped me feel confident. They cared about getting it right.



That's what we'll be measuring you against.





The details

- Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Mountain Time, with a self-directed lunch break. That is currently 10:00 PM – 7:00 AM Philippine time — a night shift. Please be certain that works for your life before applying. (The Philippine equivalent shifts by one hour twice a year with US daylight saving.)

- Type: Full-time, 40 hours/week, fully remote

- Pay: in PHP, Monthly, per the ladder above

- Tools: HubSpot (CRM), Quo (calls and texts), Tawk.to (live chat), Gmail, Shopify

- Onboarding: Structured, with documented training, recorded walkthroughs, and direct coaching from the owner. You will not be dropped in and left to figure it out.

- Reports to: Andrew, the owner, directly. Small team — your work is visible and it matters.





How to apply:

 your application to: 



Follow these instructions exactly. This is the first test.



1. Subject line — exactly this, nothing else:



I build confidence



2. Paragraph one. Maximum 3 lines, black text. Who you are and what you've sold before.



3. Paragraph two. Maximum 3 lines, blue text, size 14. Not why you want the job — why we should want you.



4. Voice recording — REQUIRED. 60–90 seconds. Unscripted. Please don't read from a script — we can hear it, and it defeats the purpose.



Answer this out loud, as if you were actually on the phone:



"A customer calls and asks whether a four-post car lift will fit in their garage. You don't know the answer. What do you say to them?"



There's no single correct answer. We're listening for two things: how you sound, and how you think when you don't know something. Record it however is easiest for you — phone, laptop, any app. Attach the file or include a shareable link.



5. Attach your resume, or a short bullet list of your relevant experience.



Applications missing the voice recording will not be reviewed. Applications with a different subject line will not be reviewed.





What happens next

1. We listen to your recording. This is where most applications end.

2. A written customer scenario — a real situation, answered in your own words.

3. An unscripted video call. No presentation, just a conversation.

4. Final interview with Andrew, plus references or proof of past performance.

5. Offer — with a start date and your Stage 0 training plan in writing.



Please be patient with us. We hire slowly and deliberately, and we receive a very large number of applications. Reviewing them properly takes time, and we may not be able to respond to everyone. We would rather take a few extra weeks than put the wrong person in this seat — which is also how we'll treat you once you're here.







Thank you for reading all the way through. If this sounds like the right fit, we'd genuinely like to hear from you.



— Andrew, Open Door Garage

title: Merchant Support Specialist
description:
ABOUT US



Stock2Cash is an Australian, technology-driven eCommerce business helping retailers, brands, wholesalers, and other businesses unlock value from inventory by connecting products with online customers.



As we continue to grow, we are building a stronger eCommerce Operations team to support the increasing number of merchants joining the Stock2Cash platform.



We are looking for a Merchant Support Specialist who can provide professional, responsive, and reliable support to our merchants while helping ensure their questions, concerns, and operational issues are handled appropriately.



ABOUT THE ROLE



The Merchant Support Specialist will be responsible for helping merchants with their day-to-day questions, requests, and concerns.



You will be one of the important points of contact between our merchants and the Stock2Cash team.



The role requires someone who can understand what a merchant is asking, investigate the situation, determine what needs to happen, resolve issues where appropriate, and involve the right people when additional expertise or action is required.



You will frequently deal with situations where the information provided by a merchant may be incomplete, unclear, or require investigation.



We are therefore looking for someone who does not simply forward messages, but can:

Understand → Investigate → Resolve → Coordinate → Follow Through → Confirm



We will provide the objectives, resources, and support required to perform the role.



You will be expected to use your own judgment and experience to determine how to handle each situation appropriately.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your responsibilities will include:



- Respond to merchant questions, requests, and concerns professionally and promptly.

- Understand and clarify the merchant's needs before taking action.

- Investigate merchant issues using available information and resources.

- Provide accurate information and assistance to merchants.

- Resolve routine issues within your level of responsibility.

- Identify issues that require assistance or action from another team.

- Coordinate with relevant internal teams to help resolve merchant concerns.

- Follow up on outstanding issues and requests.

- Keep merchants appropriately informed when an issue cannot be resolved immediately.

- Monitor open matters until they reach an appropriate resolution.

- Confirm that the requested issue or concern has been properly addressed.

- Maintain accurate records of merchant interactions and relevant actions.

- Identify recurring problems or patterns that may require broader attention.

- Recognize when a merchant concern may represent a performance, retention, or growth opportunity.

- Communicate relevant concerns to the appropriate internal team.

- Help maintain a professional and positive merchant experience.

- Take ownership of assigned merchant requests from initial contact through resolution or appropriate escalation.

- Manage multiple requests and priorities while maintaining accuracy and responsiveness.

- Contribute ideas that may improve merchant support and the overall merchant experience.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who can demonstrate real experience, not simply claim that they are helpful, responsive, proactive, or customer-focused.



You should be someone who:



- Do not immediately assume you understand the problem.

- Do not automatically pass every question or problem to another person.

- Can explain information and next steps in a way that merchants can easily understand.

- Do not assume that your responsibility ends simply because you forwarded the issue to another person.

- Are comfortable dealing with frustrated customers, urgent requests, competing priorities, or situations where the answer is not immediately available.

- Should know when an issue requires someone with different authority, expertise, or responsibility.

- Understands that sending a message is not the same as resolving an issue.



MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years of relevant professional experience in customer support, customer service, merchant support, account management, customer success, eCommerce operations, or a related field.

- Experience working directly with customers, clients, merchants, suppliers, or business partners.

- Strong written and verbal English communication.

- Strong customer-service and relationship-management skills.

- Strong organizational skills.

- Strong problem-solving ability.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Strong follow-up skills.

- Ability to investigate and understand problems before responding.

- Ability to manage multiple requests and priorities.

- Ability to work independently.

- Comfortable using spreadsheets, online systems, and business software.

- Demonstrated ability to take ownership of assigned responsibilities.



EXPERIENCE THAT WOULD BE AN ADVANTAGE



The following experience would be advantageous:



- eCommerce customer support;

- Merchant support;

- Customer success;

- Account management;

- eCommerce operations;

- Marketplace operations;

- Order and fulfillment support;

- Inventory-related support;

- Product or listing support;

- CRM systems;

- Ticketing or support systems;

- Project or task management systems;

- Working with Australian businesses or customers.



These are advantages, not substitutes for strong communication, judgment, problem-solving, and ownership.



What matters to us is whether you have the experience and ability to understand a merchant's concern, investigate the situation, determine an appropriate response, communicate clearly, and take ownership of the matter through resolution or appropriate escalation. This distinction is intentional and follows our recruitment philosophy.



HOW TO APPLY?



To apply, please provide the following:

1. Your resume — this must be provided as a public, downloadable link.

2. A snapshot of your qualification and relevant experience



Answer the following questions:



1. Tell us about a time when you dealt with a difficult or frustrated customer, client, merchant, or business partner. What was the situation, how did you handle it, and what was the outcome?

2. Tell us about a time when you received a request or problem that you could not immediately answer or resolve. How did you approach the situation, what did you do, and how did you make sure it was properly handled?

3. Tell us about a time when you had to d
 whether to solve a problem yourself or involve another person or department. How did you make that decision, and what was the result?

4. Tell us about a time when you had to follow up repeatedly on an issue because another person or department had not yet completed what was required. How did you handle the situation, and what was the final outcome?



NOTE: Please answer based on your actual experience. We are interested in what you have actually done, not what you think we want to hear. There is no requirement to use specific terminology or provide the "perfect" answer. At the end of your application, please include the exact phrase: "Push Boundaries" This confirms that you have read the full job post and application requirements. Applications that do not follow the application instructions may not be considered.



OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS



Our recruitment process consists of four stages. If you are successful in this first stage, you will be invited to complete a written assessment. If you are not successful, you will receive a decline notification.



Each stage is designed to help us better understand your experience, approach, and suitability for the role as we progress through the process.



READY TO APPLY?



If you believe your experience and approach are a strong match for the role, we would like to hear from you. Please submit your application with the information requested above.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
About Us:

4ocean is on a mission to end the ocean plastic crisis and we are looking for passionate, talented people to help us achieve this goal.  We are more than just a brand/company/employer. We are a global movement committed to making a tangible difference in the health of our planet by removing plastic waste from the ocean and coastlines. We also advocate for sustainable change. 

If you are driven by purpose, motivated to contribute to a cause that truly matters, and eager to make a lasting impact on the environment, we want you on our team.



Position Overview:

The Senior Graphic Designer is a hands-on creative leader responsible for defining and executing the visual identity of our product line content across eCommerce and Wholesale channels blending creative design with marketing strategy. 

Reporting directly to the Managing Director, Product, this role sits at the intersection of brand storytelling, digital marketing, and product presentation. You’ll manage a Graphic Designer and serve as the creative authority on all product content — from the imagery that drives online conversion to the sell sheets and packaging that move product through wholesale partners.

This is a role best suited for someone who thinks strategically, executes precisely, and cares deeply about the mission behind the work.



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Leadership & Strategy

•      Own the creative vision for all product content across eCommerce and Wholesale, ensuring brand consistency and mission alignment at every touchpoint.

•    Owns creative direction across all digital channels: paid social (Meta, TikTok), Amazon,
, DTC site, and any emerging placements. Brand standards don’t drift on this person’s watch.

•    Leads production of both static and video assets, from concept through delivery.

•    Owns creative direction across all digital channels: paid social (Meta, TikTok), Amazon,
, DTC site, and any emerging placements.

•    Act as the operational infrastructure behind the creative. Build and maintain a creative asset library and production workflow, including naming conventions, version control, delivery specs by platform.

•     Partner with the Managing Director, Product to translate business goals into compelling visual narratives.

•     Establish and maintain brand guidelines for product content, photography direction, and digital design standards.

•     Stay ahead of digital design trends, platform algorithm changes, and wholesale presentation best practices.

eCommerce Content

•     Oversee the creation of all product listing assets including primary images, lifestyle photography, infographics, and A+ / enhanced content.

•     Optimize visual content for conversion across owned DTC channels and third-party platforms (e.g., Amazon, retail partner portals).

•     Collaborate with the eCommerce and marketing teams to develop campaign creative, landing pages, and promotional assets.

•     Analyze content performance data and iterate on creative strategy accordingly.

•    Manage multiple concurrent production cycles without dropping handoffs. Product launches, seasonal campaigns, evergreen content, and paid creative tests all run in parallel.



Wholesale Content

•     Develop and maintain a suite of wholesale-facing materials including line sheets, sell sheets, trade show assets, and retail display concepts.

•     Ensure product photography and specifications meet the requirements of key wholesale partners and retail buyers.

•     Support seasonal product launches with tailored wholesale creative packages.

Team Management

•     Directly manage and mentor the Graphic Designer, providing clear briefs, constructive feedback, and professional development support.

•     Build and manage a freelance network (photographers, videographers, editors, etc) as needed for campaign productions.

•     Prioritize and manage the creative workload across projects, balancing quality with speed-to-market.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

•     Work closely with Product, Marketing, and Sales teams to ensure creative assets are aligned with product roadmaps and go-to-market timelines.

•     Partner with the eCommerce team on UX/UI creative decisions that support the online shopping experience.

•     Brief and manage external agencies or production vendors when applicable.

•     Partner directly with paid media to close the feedback loop.

•    Direct internal creators and any external agency or freelance talent. Clear briefing, sharp feedback, no ambiguity about what good looks like.

•    Manages multiple concurrent production cycles without dropping handoffs. Product launches, seasonal campaigns, evergreen content, and paid creative tests all run in parallel.

•    Interface with paid media, organic social,
, and wholesale channels as needed. Cross-functional by default, not by exception.



Qualifications:

Required

•     Minimum 5 years of experience in digital creative, brand design, or content production, with at least 2 years in a management or lead role.

•     Demonstrated experience creating product content for eCommerce platforms (DTC and/or marketplace).

•     Strong portfolio showcasing product photography direction, digital design, and brand-consistent visual storytelling.

•     Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and familiarity with Figma or similar tools.

•     Experience briefing and directing photographers, videographers, or other creative vendors.

•     Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

•     Knows the difference between a scroll-stopping hook frame and a pretty image that converts nobody.

•     Brand standards don’t drift on your watch.

•    You’re not a passenger on the analytics side. You read performance data (ie. CTR, hook rate, thumb-stop, ROAS by creative) and act on it.

•    Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, After Effects) and Figma. Working fluency in generative AI tools (Midjourney, Firefly, or equivalent) is not optional. PXM software is a plus.

•    You understand the authenticity of mission-first content architecture.

Preferred

•      Background in consumer goods, sustainability, outdoor, or lifestyle brands.

•      Experience with Shopify or similar eCommerce platforms.

•      Familiarity with retail buyer presentation formats and wholesale portal requirements.

•      Passion for ocean conservation or environmental causes.

title: Real Estate Commercial Cold Caller
description:
Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller

Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience Required: 1–2 Years



Turn Your Voice Into Your Biggest Asset



Are you the person who can get a "no" and still walk away with a callback? Do you thrive on the thrill of a great pitch and love closing the gap between a cold lead and a booked appointment? We're looking for a Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller who's ready to bring energy, persistence, and persuasion to a growing, fast-paced commercial real estate team.

This isn't just dialing numbers — it's the front line of our acquisitions pipeline for commercial properties, including office, retail, industrial, multifamily (5+ units), and mixed-use assets. Every call you make has the potential to turn into a deal, and every deal you help set up is a direct reflection of your skill on the phone. Commercial deals move differently than residential — longer relationships, bigger stakes, and owners or decision-makers who expect a caller who sounds like they know the space.

If you're confident, quick on your feet, and genuinely enjoy the game of turning "not interested" into "let's talk," we want to hear from you.



What You'll Do



Make outbound cold calls to commercial property owners, landlords, investors, asset managers, and brokers across asset classes (office, retail, industrial, multifamily, mixed-use)

Pull and build targeted call lists using county records, CRE data platforms, and public/private property databases

Identify and qualify off-market and undervalued commercial properties based on owner motivation, property condition, and financial indicators

Gather key property details: lease type (NNN, gross, modified gross), tenant occupancy/vacancy status, square footage, zoning, and ownership structure

Research and reach decision-makers directly — including owners, property managers, LLC representatives, and asset managers — not just front-desk contacts

Set qualified appointments for our acquisitions/sales team with clear notes on deal potential

Maintain and update CRM with detailed call notes, property data, and lead status

Follow call scripts while keeping conversations natural, credible, and tailored to commercial owners

Hit daily/weekly call volume, talk-time, and lead generation targets

Handle objections with confidence — especially from sophisticated owners, brokers, and gatekeepers who are used to fielding investor calls



What You Bring



1–2 years of experience in a call center handling international accounts, and/or real estate cold calling — commercial experience strongly preferred

Excellent English communication skills (neutral accent preferred)

Comfort speaking with business owners, investors, and brokers — not just residential homeowners

Strong persuasion and negotiation instincts — you know how to read a conversation and steer it

Ability to work independently and stay motivated with minimal supervision

Comfort with high-volume outbound calling and skip tracing/contact research

Experience pulling and building your own lead lists (county records, CRE data platforms, or similar tools)

A target-driven mindset and genuine competitive streak

Familiarity with CRM systems (a plus, not a must)



Bonus Points For



Working knowledge of commercial real estate terminology: cap rate, NOI, NNN/gross leases, cash-on-cash return, CRE asset classes

Experience cold calling for office, retail, industrial, or multifamily acquisitions specifically

Experience with lead generation tools, skip tracing platforms, and auto-dialers

Familiarity with list-pulling/data platforms such as Prop Stream, Reonomy, CoStar, or county assessor records

Prior appointment-setting experience for acquisitions or investment sales teams

Sharp listening skills and objection-handling instincts with sophisticated, high-value prospects



Why You'll Want This Role



Competitive base salary — get rewarded for showing up and doing the work

Performance-based incentives/bonuses — the better you perform, the more you earn

Real growth opportunities — this is a growing company, and top performers won't go unnoticed

A supportive, performance-driven team — we win together, and we celebrate wins



Ready to Make Your Calls Count?



Send your updated resume and a short recording (Loom or Vocaroo — link only)

Application – Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller

title: Senior Graphics & Packaging Designer
description:
Full-time | 40 hours/week | $2,000 USD/month + 13th Month Pay | Immediate Start



**ABOUT US**

Intent Brands owns two growing consumer brands sold through Amazon and Shopify: SurviveX, a premium first aid and emergency preparedness brand, and Aerotrunk, a premium hardside luggage brand.



Website: 



**THE ROLE**

We're looking for a senior-level designer who can own the visual output of both brands, from retail packaging and Amazon A+ content to ecommerce and social media, with minimal supervision.



We're a small, fast-moving team. You won't be "the designer who gets handed mockups to resize." You'll own the entire visual output for both brands — from packaging dielines to Amazon A+ content to social media assets. Your work will be on shelves, in search results, and in customers' hands.



**What You'll Do**

-Design retail packaging, inserts, labels and production-ready artwork

-Create Amazon listing images, infographics and A+ Content

-Design Amazon Brand Store and Shopify assets

-Create social media and marketing graphics

-Retouch, composite and art-direct product imagery

-Maintain and evolve both brands' visual identities



***What We're Looking For**

We're not looking for someone who simply knows Photoshop. We want a designer with a portfolio that makes us want to hire them immediately.





***MUST HAVE**

1.) Real retail packaging experience that has gone to print

2.) Strong knowledge of dielines, bleeds, safe zones, spot colours and substrates

3.) Amazon listing and A+ Content experience

4.) Strong print-production knowledge: CMYK, Pantone, PDF/X and press-ready files

5.) Advanced Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign skills

6.) Excellent typography, layout and visual hierarchy

7.) Strong written English and ability to work independently



**BONUS/ NICE TO HAVE**

-After Effects / motion graphics

-Blender / Dimension / 3D

-Midjourney, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion or similar

-Figma

-Medical or health product packaging experience

-FDA/regulatory labelling experience



***PLEASE ANSWER ALL THE FOUR QUESTIONS**

TAKE NOTE: Include the phrase "I Design For Production" of the first line your application. This tells us you've read the full listing.



IMPORTANT: Please include links to your portfolio or relevant work, along with your responses to the following questions:



QUESTION #1.) Show us two packaging project you're particularly proud of that went into physical production. 

Please tell us:

-What was the product?

-What were the print specifications and constraints? 

-What was your process from concept through final artwork? 

-Did this product include any packaging inserts, user manuals, or multi-page guides? 

-If so, show us how you prepared those layouts (e.g., using InDesign) for production.

-Can you show the physical printed product alongside your design?

**Share us the link of it. Actual printed products are strongly preferred over mockups.**



QUESTION #2.) Amazon Design Challenge

Choose one scenario:

*Option A:  Our first aid kit's main Amazon image has a 3% click-through rate, compared with a category average of 4.5%. The current image is a straightforward product shot on white.

*Option B: We're launching a new luggage product and need seven Amazon listing images.

What would you change, and why? What would you A/B test first?

What would you put in each image slot, and why?



We're interested in your thinking, not just your final design.



QUESTION #3.) Two Very Different Brands:

SurviveX is medical/tactical: red, black, authoritative and confident.

Aerotrunk is modern, premium and aspirational, with a travel/lifestyle focus.



How would you design for two very different brands without making them feel like the work of the same brand?

Give us a specific technique, process or example from your experience.



QUESTION #4.) Your Tools & Workflow

-Tell us your complete design stack.

-Specifically for Adobe InDesign: How do you use it in your packaging workflow (e.g., product inserts, user guides, multi-page manuals, or style guides)?

-Figma: How do you incorporate Figma into your workflow (e.g., e-commerce asset planning, component libraries, UI/Shopify graphics, or collaborative layout)?

-Also tell us your typical turnaround time for creating a complete set of seven Amazon listing images, from brief to final delivery.



***SHORT-LISTED APPLICANTS WILL ADVANCED TO OUR PAID DESIGN TEST**

We believe the best way to evaluate a designer is to look at their actual work.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a paid design test ($100 USD) instead of going through multiple rounds of interviews.



The test will involve:

Redesigning three existing SurviveX Amazon listing images

Creating a front-and-back packaging insert based on a supplied dieline and brief

We'll provide the brand guidelines, existing assets and a clear brief.



We'll be evaluating: Design quality, Brand interpretation, Commercial thinking , Production readiness, Attention to detail, Turnaround speed



********WE OFFER THE BEST DEAL!!!********

SALARY: $2,000 USD/month

Paid biweekly via direct deposit.



13th Month Pay: Standard Philippine benefit.

Paid Time Off: Philippine holidays plus 15 days of personal leave.



Creative Ownership: You'll have genuine influence over how two growing brands look and communicate.

Small, Direct Team: You'll work closely with the founders without layers of middle management.

Room to Grow: As the brands grow, there's potential to progress into a Design Lead or Creative Director role.



***HOW TO APPLY***

Please include all of the following:

Answers to all four screening questions

The phrase "I design for production"

A link to your portfolio

At least two examples of physical product packaging you designed

Your expected rate and availability



Your portfolio can be on Behance, Dribbble, your own website, Google Drive or another platform. We care about the work, not where you host it.



**Applications without a portfolio or completed screening questions will not be reviewed.**

We aim to review applications within 48 hours. Shortlisted candidates will receive the paid design test within one week.



THANK YOU AND WE ARE LOOKING FORWARD TO SEE YOUR APPLICATIONS!

title: Real Estate Agent Recruiter — Aggressive Phone Closer — Hourly + Bonus — Courted Experience a Plus
description:
We are a high-converting Zillow Preferred Partner team (aka Zillow Flex) with 60+ agents across six Florida markets. Our agents get real Zillow connections — live buyer and seller leads handed to them — and we are expanding. Your job is to get top-producing and hungry agents on the phone and close them on joining our team.



This is a phone sales job. You will make outbound calls, texts, and
s to real estate agents all day. If you are looking for an admin role, a research role, or a "send LinkedIn messages" role — this is not it. We need a closer who is aggressive, persistent, and comfortable hearing "no" fifty times to get to one "yes."



If you cannot pick up a phone and pitch a stranger, do not apply.



WHAT YOU WILL DO (daily)

Make 100+ outbound dials per day to licensed real estate agents from our target lists

Pitch the opportunity: real Zillow buyer and seller connections, proven conversion systems, coaching, and a team that closes.



Handle objections in real time ("I'm happy where I am," "I don't pay splits," "Zillow leads are junk") and keep the conversation alive.



Follow up relentlessly: multi-touch cadences by phone, SMS, and
. No lead goes cold.



Track every touch in our CRM and recruiting pipeline; report daily numbers (dials, conversations, appointments) in Slack

Work our target lists, including named priority targets and market-specific campaigns



HARD REQUIREMENTS — DO NOT APPLY WITHOUT ALL OF THESE:



Minimum 3 years of recruiting experience — real estate agent recruiting, sales recruiting, or high-volume outbound recruiting. You have recruited people over the phone for a living.



Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent — you will be talking to US real estate agents all day and you must sound confident and credible on the phone. You will submit a voice recording with your application (see below). No recording = deleted.



Proven phone closing skills — you can pitch, handle objections, and ask for the appointment without a script holding your hand

Aggressive, competitive, thick-skinned. Rejection does not slow you down.



Available full time on US Eastern Time hours (9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST) — agents answer phones during US business hours, so that's when you work.



Reliable computer, quality USB headset, backup internet, quiet workspace (no roosters, no traffic, no background noise on calls)



If you do not meet every requirement above, do not apply. Applications missing the voice recording or the experience will be deleted without response.



YOUR APPLICATION GOES TO THE TOP IF YOU HAVE:

title: Customer Service & Business Development Executive
description:
Customer Service & Business Development Executive

We're looking for a dynamic, well-spoken individual to join the SuperClean SG team as a Customer Service & Business Development Executive — a hybrid role that combines exceptional customer care with proactive outreach to grow our office and commercial cleaning business.



About SuperClean SG (superclean.sg/)

SuperClean SG is Singapore's fastest-growing, technology-enabled cleaning company, redefining how cleaning services are booked and delivered. We leverage technology to streamline operations, ensuring efficiency, transparency, and top-tier service quality for our customers.



We are relentlessly focused on our customers, always striving to exceed expectations and deliver an exceptional experience. Our goal is simple — reliable, high-quality service that makes our customers' lives better, whether that means making their day easier or giving them peace of mind.



As a young and dynamic company, we seek like-minded individuals passionate about service excellence, communication, and growth. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and want to be part of a company that values your contribution, join us and help shape the future of cleaning in Singapore.



What You'll Do



Customer Service

- Inbound Inquiries & Bookings: Handle customer inquiries via phone, WhatsApp, and
, guiding customers through booking options and answering service-related questions with clarity and confidence.

- Job Confirmations & Scheduling Support: Work closely with operations to confirm bookings, assign cleaners, and accommodate special requests.

- Client Issues & Escalations: Address complaints, investigate service issues, and resolve disputes efficiently with a professional, empathetic tone.

- Client-Initiated Changes: Process amendments, rescheduling, and cancellations while minimising disruption to operations.

- Service Quality Follow-ups: Check in with clients post-service to gather feedback and reinforce our commitment to quality.

- Invoice & Payment Support: Assist customers with billing and payments, coordinating with Finance on disputed invoices.



Sales & Business Development

- Outbound Prospecting: Proactively reach potential office and commercial cleaning clients through
, messaging platforms, calls, and other channels — opening conversations, generating interest, and booking site visits or quotes.

- Lead Qualification & Follow-up: Manage a pipeline of prospects, follow up consistently, and nurture leads from first contact through to closed deal.

- Quotations & Proposals: Prepare and send service quotes for office cleaning prospects, coordinating with operations on scoping and pricing.



Across the Board

- Customer Retention & Relationship Management: Build strong relationships with repeat and commercial clients, driving satisfaction, loyalty, and referrals.

- Process & SOP Development: Help build and improve standard operating procedures (SOPs) and playbooks for both customer service and outbound initiatives — turning what works into clear, repeatable steps the team can follow.

- Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with Operations and Finance to ensure smooth service delivery, accurate quotes, and timely issue resolution.



What We're Looking For

- Excellent Spoken & Written English: Confident, clear, and professional on the phone and in writing — comfortable cold-calling and handling inbound calls with poise. (Additional languages such as Mandarin a plus.)

- Customer Service Experience: Prior experience in a customer-facing role, ideally in service-based industries such as cleaning, hospitality, or facilities management.

- Sales Instinct: Comfortable with outbound outreach and not afraid to pick up the phone or send the first message; motivated by hitting targets and closing deals.

- Problem-Solving & Conflict Resolution: Skilled at turning negative experiences into positive outcomes.

- Tech-Savvy & Process-Oriented: Comfortable using CRM, ticketing, and scheduling tools to manage customer and prospect interactions efficiently.

- Detail-Oriented & Organised: Tracks multiple inquiries, prospects, and follow-ups without dropping the ball.

- Able to Document Processes: Can write clear, practical SOPs and playbooks so good practices get shared and scaled across the team.

- Self-Driven & Resilient: Thrives in a fast-paced environment, stays motivated through rejection, and manages high volumes while maintaining quality.

- Team Player: Works well with Operations and Finance to ensure smooth execution.



Working Arrangements

- 6-day work week, including weekends and Singapore public holidays (on a roster), in line with our service operating hours.



Why Join Us?

- Be part of a fast-growing, innovative company that values your contributions.

- A hybrid role with real ownership — your outreach directly fuels our commercial growth.

- A dynamic, supportive team with genuine opportunities for advancement.

- Competitive salary with performance incentives tied to sales results.

If you're ready to make an impact in a customer-focused, growth-driven environment and help shape the future of cleaning in Singapore, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Business Funding Sales Consultant
description:
Location: Remote

Salary: $450 USD per month, plus performance-based incentives

Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm (UK Time)



About the Role



We're looking for a motivated, ambitious Sales Consultant to help UK businesses access the funding and payment solutions they need to grow.



We're a close-knit, ambitious team that believes exceptional customer service starts with exceptional people. Every conversation with a client matters, and we're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys speaking with people, building relationships, and creating a fantastic first impression.



This isn't just another remote job. We're looking for someone who wants to become an important part of our journey, contribute ideas, take ownership of their work, and develop into new roles as the business continues to expand.



If you're looking for a role where your hard work will be recognised and rewarded, we'd love to hear from you.



The Opportunity



You'll speak with business owners, understand their needs, build strong relationships, and recommend suitable business funding and card payment solutions.



This is a consultative sales role. Trust, communication and excellent customer service matter just as much as hitting targets.



We're not looking for someone who simply follows a script. We're looking for someone who can hold natural conversations, bring positive energy to every call, make people feel comfortable, and represent our business with professionalism and enthusiasm.



As the business grows, there will be opportunities to take on additional responsibilities and progress into more senior positions.

* Contact new and existing business owners by telephone,
 and video call.

* Build rapport and establish long-term client relationships.

* Understand each client's business and financial requirements.

* Qualify businesses for funding solutions.

* Present and explain funding products clearly and professionally.

* Introduce businesses to suitable card payment solutions and terminals.

* Prepare quotations and funding proposals.

* Follow up enquiries and maintain regular communication.

* Work towards and exceed monthly sales targets and KPIs.

* Ensure all sales are completed compliantly and accurately.

* Stay up to date with industry products, lenders and payment providers.



Who We're Looking For



This role is perfect for someone who:



* Loves speaking with people.

* Has a naturally positive personality and brings energy to every conversation.

* Builds trust and rapport quickly.

* Makes customers feel comfortable.

* Is an excellent communicator with fluent spoken English.

* Takes pride in their work.

* Is organised, reliable and self motivated.

* Enjoys learning and developing new skills.

* Takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.

* Wants to grow with a business rather than simply work for one.

* Is excited by the opportunity to develop into future leadership or operational roles.



Previous experience in sales, telesales, customer service, lead generation or call centres is beneficial, but not essential.



What Success Looks Like



Success in this role isn't simply about making calls.



You'll be successful if you:



* Build genuine relationships with clients.

* Create a positive customer experience.

* Qualify enquiries accurately.

* Present funding and payment solutions clearly.

* Meet and exceed performance targets.

* Represent the business professionally.

* Show initiative and continuously look for ways to improve.



Performance Expectations



During your probationary period, you'll be expected to:



* Maintain accurate CRM records.

* Deliver excellent customer service on every call.

* Meet agreed quality standards and monthly sales targets.

* Follow compliance requirements accurately.



Quality is just as important as quantity. We value meaningful conversations that create an excellent customer experience.



Career Progression



We're hiring for potential, not just experience.



This role is designed for someone who wants to build a long term career within our business. As we continue to grow, there will be opportunities to progress into areas such as:



* Team Leadership

* Operations

* Training and Coaching

* Business Development

* Process Improvement



We regularly review performance and recognise those who consistently deliver excellent results. High performing team members will have opportunities for performance based incentives, salary reviews, increased responsibilities, and progression into senior positions as the company grows.



Equipment Requirements



Applicants must have:



* A reliable computer or laptop.

* Stable high speed internet.

* A high quality headset and microphone.

* A quiet workspace suitable for professional customer calls.



Why Join Us?



* Genuine opportunities for career progression.

* Ongoing training and support.

* Performance based incentives.

* Regular salary reviews based on performance.

* A supportive team that values your ideas and contributions.

* The chance to become an important part of a growing company from an early stage.



How to Apply



Please submit:



* Your CV/Resume.

We're not just looking for someone to hit targets. We're looking for someone who wants to build relationships, make a genuine impact, and grow with our business.

title: Copywriter / AI Prompter — Remote (Long-Term)
description:
⚠️ READ THE FULL AD BEFORE APPLYING ⚠️



We are only considering candidates who: HAVE REAL COPYWRITING EXPERIENCE.

YOU WILL BE INTERVIEWED BY OUR AI. If you can't get past a smart, well-prepared AI interviewer, you won't get past this filter — so come ready with real work to show.



ABOUT US



IMSOLD is an AI-first creative agency that rebuilds paid acquisition for brands running serious ad spend across Meta, TikTok, Google, YouTube, and Reddit. We don't chase awards — we chase sharp ideas that convert, shipped fast. Our teams produce dozens of tested creative variants every month (UGC scripts, statics, motion, landing pages) for D2C, SaaS, digital health, and subscription brands. 



If you like slow-moving, over-managed teams, this isn't for you. If you like fast feedback loops, real ownership, and getting judged on output instead of hours logged, keep reading.



THE ROLE



We need a Copywriter / AI Prompter who can write high-converting copy for our page projects — and who knows how to work WITH AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) rather than just asking them for a paragraph and pasting it in. You should understand marketing psychology well enough to know why a hook works, not just that it "sounds good."



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Write high-converting copy for landing pages, sales pages, and funnels

- Create and optimize AI prompts specifically for copy generation

- Edit and sharpen AI-generated content for clarity, tone, and conversions

- Write
 sequences, ad copy, and short-form marketing content

- Do basic research on target audience, competitors, and offers

- Follow brand voice and marketing guidelines across projects

- Collaborate closely with marketing and design teams



WHAT YOU NEED TO HAVE



- A university degree (non-negotiable)

- Proven copywriting experience, with a portfolio you can show us

- Strong understanding of sales funnels and conversion copy (preferred)

- Real, hands-on experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or similar) to produce and refine content — not just casual use

- Excellent English writing and grammar (this gets tested)

- The discipline to meet deadlines and work independently, remotely

- Sharp attention to detail and strong self-editing skills



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with ClickFunnels, GoHighLevel, or similar funnel builders

- Solid grasp of digital marketing and buyer psychology

- Experience writing for B2B or SaaS products



WORKING DETAILS



- 100% remote

- Part-time or full-time — to be discussed based on fit

- Long-term opportunity for the right person, with room to grow as we scale



HOW TO APPLY

To apply:

2. Include a link to your copywriting portfolio or writing samples.

3. In 2-3 sentences, tell us about a time you used AI to speed up or improve a piece of copy — and what you changed before it was good enough to ship.



Be prepared: shortlisted candidates will be interviewed by our AI before speaking to a human. Come with real examples, not just claims.

ABOUT THE ROLE



We run Klaudius, a tool that finds businesses with no website, builds them one automatically, and pitches the owner. Our Instagram is our best sales channel and we post far too rarely. We want one person producing short-form video daily.



You can learn more about our product at: 



You get a free licence to the software and you record it in action. You don't need to run it constantly - a session here and there should give you material for several videos.



You can see our existing instagram page (
v) to see what kind of reels have worked vs not worked for us in the past. Treat them as a floor rather than a ceiling. We want your ideas too.



WHAT THE WORK LOOKS LIKE



- Record the software in action (we give you a free licence and pay for your AI subscription).

- D
 what's interesting in the footage and what the angle is.

- Cut it into a vertical reel, add on-screen hook text.

- Post to both Instagram and TikTok (after a probation period).

- Set up and maintain the ManyChat automations - the comment-keyword triggers and the auto-DM that sends the link. The automation handles comment replies; you keep it working and add a new trigger whenever a video uses a new keyword.



You won't handle DMs. Once someone replies to the automation, that conversation is mine - it's a sales conversation and I want to be the one having it. You own everything up to the point the DM lands.



You won't be on camera and your voice won't be used. Where a video needs a face or spoken commentary, flag it and I'll record that part myself. So you don't need to be comfortable presenting - the work is behind the camera.



WHAT THESE VIDEOS ARE FOR



Not just views or followers. The goal is sales of the product. A video that gets 100,000 views and sells nothing has failed; one that gets 3,000 views and puts buyers in our DMs has worked.



The mechanic that's worked best is a comment gate: the video asks people to comment a keyword, and an automation (ManyChat) then DMs them a link - either to the Klaudius website or to a blog post about the specific feature the video was about. So every video needs a reason for someone to comment, and the angle needs to appeal to someone who might actually buy, not just someone who'll watch.



We'll likely lean on this further, but we're open to other ideas if you've seen things work elsewhere.



TRIAL REELS



Many posts go out as Instagram trial reels - these are shown only to non-followers, so we can distribute at volume without flooding our existing audience. 



SCHEDULE



Daily, 7 days a week. How you schedule your own work is up to you - batch several in a day and schedule them out if you prefer. We care about what lands, not about you working weekends. Volume ramps: 1/day for the first two weeks, then 2/day, then 3/day.



What's worked for us so far is a raw, phone-recorded aesthetic, so things like transitions, music beds and heavy polish are unlikely to be needed for these videos.



REQUIREMENTS



- A computer with at least 8GB RAM. Windows or macOS both fine.

- Stable internet capable of uploading video daily.

- A (smartphone) camera good enough to shoot clear, crisp video - at least matching the quality of what's currently on 
v. A lot of our footage is a phone pointed at a screen, so the camera does real work even though the style is raw. 

- You can cut a short vertical video that holds attention. We care more about consistency over time than about one impressive showreel piece.

- An eye for which few seconds of a longer recording are worth posting, and what to say about them.

- An understanding of what our product is, how it works, and why it is impressive. I am happy to explain this all to you, but hopefully after the explanation you genuinely appreciate the product for what it is and therefore realise how best to market it in these reels.

- A rough sense of how websites work. Roughly what a CMS is, why SEO matters, what "deploying" a site means. Not expert level - just enough that when something happens on screen you know why it's interesting. Happy to explain everything anyway it's pretty simple :)

- Good written English for on-screen text, writing post captions etc.

- Your own
/Instagram account. We grant access through Meta Business Suite and TikTok Business Center, so you'll never need our passwords and you keep your own login.

- Able to keep a daily posting rhythm.



NICE TO HAVE



- You've run comment-to-DM automations before (ManyChat or similar). We'll show you ours either way, but having done it before is a plus.





WHAT WE PROVIDE



- A free licence to our software, plus your AI subscription and a CapCut subscription paid

- The formats that have worked so far, with the real numbers behind them

- A caption bank for the proven formats, and help writing copy for your own new ones

- A clear daily spec, no ambiguity about what "done" means





PAY



- Paid two-week trial: $250 for 10 assets. This is the first two weeks of the job, not a separate audition - pass it and you carry straight on.

- Ongoing on success: $600/month.

- The rate reflects that this is a hybrid role - video skill plus product understanding - not straight editing work.





HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word BUILD so we know you read this.



Then two things:



1) Go to 
v, pick the reel you think performed best, and in three sentences say why. We know the actual numbers, so this is a real test.



2) Pitch us one video idea we haven't made yet. One or two sentences. This is most of the job, so it counts for more than anything else you send us.

title: Full Time - Professional Video Editor for E-commerce Brands
description:
We are hiring a FULL-TIME (40 hours per week, 5 days a week) AI-first Video Editor to join our fast-growing Shopify e-commerce team. This is not a casual freelance position. We are looking for a serious performance editor who is highly skilled at generating video footage with AI and understands direct-response marketing well enough to create ads that convert.



A large part of the work involves iterating on and recreating proven competitor-style video ads for our products — matching structure, beats, and pacing while changing visuals, characters, settings, and wording so the result is our own. You will be given reference videos, scripts, and detailed product specifications. You'll build the footage using a mix of AI generation and real footage, then assemble and finish the ad. If you are a traditional editor who is uncomfortable prompting AI video models, this role is not for you.



AI is heavily emphasized, but real footage matters too. Some raw footage will be provided by us; the rest you will be expected to source yourself using stock libraries, our systems, and your own initiative. You must be able to blend AI-generated and real footage so the final video feels seamless.



We provide the tool stack: Higgsfield (with access to current video models such as Seedance, Kling, and Veo) and ElevenLabs for voiceover. You must already be proficient with Higgsfield or comparable AI video platforms. Experience with Midjourney, Atria, Arcads, Heygen, Sora, and similar tools is a plus. You should be capable of generating realistic footage — a person naturally holding or using a product, lifestyle moments, product demonstrations — that looks real and does not appear artificial or overproduced. You must be able to keep a character, setting, and product consistent across multiple shots.



Our products have locked physical shapes. You will receive product geometry specs and reference images, and the product must look identical in every shot of every video. A product that changes shape between scenes or a hand with six fingers is not acceptable in a delivered video.



You will be working on company accounts with finite AI credits. We expect you to plan your shots before generating, write careful prompts, avoid spray-and-pray regeneration, and treat credits as money. Efficient credit use is a core part of this job and will be tracked.



Every video must be reviewed by you before it is sent. This is a firm rule, not a suggestion. Watch your edit back-to-back against the reference video. Check product consistency, AI artifacts (hands, morphing, warped text, flickering), audio sync, pacing, and whether every line of the script is matched by the right visual. Work sent with obvious unreviewed errors will count against you during the trial period.



Revisions are a normal part of the job. We expect minor revision notes to be turned around the same day and detailed feedback to be followed precisely. Following instructions accurately is one of the main things you will be evaluated on.



Output expectations: 5–6 videos per day on average, ranging from 30 seconds to 2 minutes. Workload varies with the season and will change throughout the year. At the end of the day, quality matters more than quantity — clean, reviewed, on-spec videos are always better than a larger number of sloppy ones.



Beyond AI generation, you need solid editing skills in Adobe Premiere Pro or CapCut Pro, including captions, sound design, basic motion graphics, and the ability to combine AI and real footage seamlessly. You should understand what makes a hook work in the first 3 seconds, how to pace for retention, and how to build emotional engagement. You should be aware of metrics like hook rate, CTR, and retention, and think like a marketer as well as an editor.



Additional responsibilities include accurate labeling and organization of all video files, working within 
 for structured reviews and feedback, and day-to-day communication on WhatsApp. You must be able to take a blueprint and not only execute it correctly but elevate it.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a test that mirrors the real job: you'll receive a reference video, a script, and product references, and you'll recreate the ad using a mix of AI-generated and real footage. You'll also report how many credits you used and how you managed them. Successful candidates then move to a one-week trial to demonstrate consistency, quality, and reliability before the full-time offer.



This is a long-term position with consistent workload and growth opportunities inside a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.



To apply, submit:



Your portfolio, including at least a few video ads made primarily with AI-generated footage (tell us which tools you used) and a few regular ads where AI has not been used.

A Loom video introducing yourself and explaining your experience with AI video generation, ad editing and marketing.

Written answers to these three questions: (a) Walk us through your Higgsfield or AI video workflow from script to finished shot. (b) How do you keep a product or character consistent across multiple generated shots? (c) How do you manage generation credits and avoid waste?

Your WhatsApp contact information

Confirmation of your availability for full-time work (40 hours per week)

Include "CLOUDBASE" in your
 subject line

Applications that don't follow these instructions won't be reviewed.
