title: Marketing & Admin VA for an iPhone app — outreach, research, reporting
description:
ABOUT



I run a small software studio (ExoLabs Studio Limited). We just launched

Traak, an iPhone app that tracks all your online orders in one place —

SHEIN, Temu, Amazon — and tells you when a package is out for delivery.

It's live on the App Store. I'm the only person on the team, which is

why I'm hiring.



I'm looking for one person to take over the repeating work around the

app so I can stay on the product. The tasks vary, but they're all the

same kind of work: careful, repeatable, done without being chased.



WHAT THE WORK LOOKS LIKE



Most of your time goes to finding creators and contacting them. You'll

search TikTok, Instagram and YouTube for people who post haul and

unboxing videos — the kind who order from SHEIN, Temu or Amazon and film

what arrives. You look for mid-sized accounts, mostly in the US, UK and

Canada, check their bio for a business
, keep everything organised

in a shared Google Sheet, and send them a collaboration
. The

is already written — you're sending it, not writing it. When someone

replies, it comes to me. You never negotiate money.



The rest of the week changes. Some of it is reading our support inbox

and answering simple questions from replies I've prepared, and passing

real bugs to me with a clear description of what the user did. Some of

it is watching new App Store reviews. Some weeks it's copying figures

into a sheet so I can see the trend, or looking at what competing apps

charge and what their reviews complain about.



I'll train you on each of these one at a time. Nobody starts knowing all

of it.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



  - Clear written English. You'll write to American creators and to our

    users. Not perfect English — clear English.

  - Comfortable with Google Sheets and Gmail. Everything runs on those.

  - Careful. This is work where one careless send does real damage, so

    I'd much rather have a few
s done properly than a lot done fast.

  - Able to work without being chased. I won't be checking on you daily.

  - Honest about what you did, including on the slow days.



WHAT YOU DON'T NEED



  - No marketing degree. No copywriting, design, or video editing.

  - No experience with apps or software.

  - No paid tools — everything is free.



HOURS AND PAY



  - 20 hours per week. You choose your schedule inside the week; I don't

    watch a timer.

  - $350 to $500 USD per month depending on experience, paid twice a

    month by Wise or PayPal.

  - Starts with one paid trial week at the same rate, on real work, so

    we both find out if it fits before committing.

  - Long term if it works, with more hours later if you want them. This

    is not a one-off project.



If this sounds like your kind of work, tell me a little about yourself

and what you've done before.

title: Video Editor
description:
AI VIDEO EDITOR - KLING & NANO BANANA PRO



We are looking for a detail-oriented and creative AI Video Editor to join our team full-time.



Your main responsibility will be turning written creative briefs into polished short-form video advertisements.



You will review a brief, generate the required base images using Nano Banana Pro, animate those images using Kling, and prepare the final video for delivery.



We will provide training on our specific systems and creative process. However, previous hands-on experience with both Kling and Nano Banana Pro is required.



This role is best suited to someone who follows instructions carefully, notices small visual details, and has a strong eye for design.



WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



- Read and understand detailed video briefs.

- Generate high-quality base images using Nano Banana Pro.

- Turn generated images into realistic video clips using Kling.

- Follow visual references closely, including character appearance, framing, setting, movement, and overall style.

- Write and adjust AI-generation prompts when necessary.

- Review generated images and clips carefully before submitting them.

- Regenerate assets when the result does not match the brief.

- Combine clips and complete basic video editing when required.

- Add subtitles, text overlays, audio, or other simple editing elements when included in the brief.

- Organize project files and export videos using the correct names, formats, and dimensions.

- Make revisions based on feedback from the creative team.

- Complete assigned videos within the agreed deadlines.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Previous hands-on experience using Kling.

- Previous hands-on experience using Nano Banana Pro.

- Strong attention to detail.

- A good eye for design, composition, framing, and visual consistency.

- Able to follow detailed written and visual instructions closely.

- Able to compare your work against a reference and notice what needs to be corrected.

- Comfortable generating multiple versions until the result is right.

- Able to understand feedback and apply it accurately.

- Strong organization and file-management skills.

- Reliable communication during working hours.

- Able to manage deadlines and complete tasks without repeated reminders.

- Reliable internet connection and a computer suitable for video-editing work.



Experience creating short-form advertisements, social media videos, UGC-style content, or e-commerce creatives is highly preferred.



Experience with CapCut, or similar video-editing software is also helpful.



IMPORTANT



We can train you on our internal workflow, naming systems, briefs, and creative standards.



However, this is not a beginner position for someone who has never used AI image or video-generation tools before. You must already have practical experience with both Kling and Nano Banana Pro.



We care more about the quality of your work and your ability to follow instructions than formal qualifications.



THIS ROLE WILL NOT SUIT SOMEONE WHO



- Has never used Kling or Nano Banana Pro.

- Skims instructions instead of reading the full brief.

- Submits the first generated result without checking its quality.

- Regularly misses small but important details.

- Struggles to match references closely.

- Becomes careless when completing repetitive revisions.

- Needs to be reminded repeatedly about deadlines.

- Disappears or becomes unresponsive during working hours.

- Is unwilling to regenerate a clip when the result is not good enough.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



After the first few months:



- You can understand our creative briefs with minimal explanation.

- Your generated characters, scenes, and video clips closely match the provided references.

- You catch visual mistakes before submitting your work.

- Videos are delivered on time and exported correctly.

- Feedback is understood and applied without the same mistakes being repeated.

- You become faster while maintaining a high standard of quality.

- The creative team can trust you to take a brief and turn it into a finished video.



SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION



- Full-time, long-term remote position.

- Working schedule: 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM Philippine Time.

- Salary: $500 to $1,000 USD per month, depending on experience and ability.

- Salary and responsibilities may be reviewed based on performance.

- This is intended to become a stable, long-term role for the right person.

title: Virtual Assistant, SEO Delivery
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a part-time Virtual Assistant who sits in every meeting, captures what was agreed, and then makes sure it actually happens. The core of this job is follow-up. You will chase internal team members and external clients until tasks are closed, and you will surface a blockage early rather than reporting it after the deadline has passed.



You need enough SEO knowledge to understand what is being chased and who owns it, and to ask a sensible clarifying question in the room rather than nodding along and getting it wrong later. Admin experience helps but is not a requirement.



Engagement Terms

- Part-time, remote, paid hourly or on a fixed monthly retainer.

- You attend all scheduled internal and client meetings.

- You must be available 30 minutes before and 30 minutes after every meeting. The before block is for prep: last meeting's notes, the open action list, and anything we owe the client that is late. The after block is for output: notes circulated same day and the first round of follow-ups sent immediately, not tomorrow.

- Meeting times follow the client, so many sit within Singapore hours but some will not. You need to be flexible outside a fixed daytime schedule.

- Once you have applied with the subject line I'm your star VA and cleared the interview, you will be added to a WhatsApp group and the relevant client Slack channels.



Key Responsibilities

- Meeting support

- Ask clarifying questions during the meeting when an action item is vague, unowned or undated.

- Prepare the pre-meeting brief in the 30 minutes before: agenda, open items and their current status, and anything overdue on our side.

- Circulate notes in the 30 minutes after, structured as decisions, action items with an owner and a date, and open questions.

Follow-up and chasing

- Follow up with internal stakeholders (writers, editors, SEO specialists, developers) on task status against the agreed dates.

- Follow up with external stakeholders (clients, client-side dev and marketing teams, guest post contacts) for approvals, website access, content sign-off, information and assets.

- Maintain one live tracker of every open item with owner, date requested, date promised, next chase date and status.

- Escalate to the account lead once a chase has failed twice, with a one-line summary of what is stuck and what it is blocking. Do not simply forward the

- Flag risk in writing before a deadline is missed, not after.

- Admin support

- Maintaining trackers, folder structure and file naming in Google Drive.

- Formatting and tidying decks, reports and documents.

- Light data entry into Google Sheets and the project management tool.



Preferred Skills

- Working knowledge of SEO. You do not need to run campaigns, but you should understand on-page, off-page and technical -SEO, what a brief is, what a meta title does, and roughly why rankings take time.

- Confident, persistent follow-up. You are comfortable chasing people more senior than you and clients who have gone quiet.

- Excellent written English. Your notes and chase messages go directly to clients.

- Clear spoken English, since you will be asking questions live on client calls.

- Strong organisation. One tracker, kept current, with nothing held only in your head.

- Google Sheets: filters, sorting, conditional formatting. VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP is a bonus.

- Familiarity with a project management tool (Asana, ClickUp, Trello, Monday or Notion).

title: Editor
description:
Role Overview



We are looking for skilled editors who can generate an article from our brief using AI and then edit it into something a real reader would finish and a client would be proud to publish. You are not a writer and you will not be starting from a blank page. 

You own the piece from generation through to the version that goes to the client. You will work across client industries, currently weighted towards healthcare, with expansion into finance and other verticals.



This is not proofreading. Grammar and spelling are the floor, not the job. The hard part is the human factor. AI will hand you something fluent, confident and completely generic, and your job is to turn that into something that reads like a person who knows the subject wrote it. The finished article has to answer what the reader actually searched for, say something the first three Google results do not, and carry none of the tells that make a reader stop trusting the page.



Engagement Terms

- Tasks are posted in a WhatsApp group on a first come, first served basis, the same group you are added to once you have applied with the subject line I'm your star editor and cleared the test. The first person to claim a task owns it. If it is not delivered by the stated deadline, it goes back to the group.

- There is no minimum volume, but consistent editors get first sight of the bigger jobs.

- You will be given the client's style guide, the SEO brief and the target keyword for each piece.



Key Responsibilities

Writing quality

- Generate the first draft from our brief, target keyword and the SERP competitors using AI. Prompt it with the brief, the competitor pages and the client's existing copy rather than a one-line instruction. The raw output is your starting point, never your deliverable.

- Strip the AI tells before anyone else sees it: uniform paragraph lengths, em dashes, empty openers, hedged claims, lists with nothing specific in them, and confident statements with no source behind them.

- Ensure the text is free from grammar, spelling and punctuation errors.

- Keep the language user-friendly and concise. Cut filler.

- Match the client's house voice, including US or UK spelling as instructed per client.



Reader experience

- Logical: establish authority and credibility using supporting evidence such as statistics, academic publications, case studies, testimonials, Google reviews and relevant endorsements.

 Emotional: create a sense of assurance and connection. Use the PEEL structure (Point, Elaboration, Example, Link) and keep it authentic and relatable.

- Highlight and sharpen the client's unique selling points so the piece does not read like every competitor's page.



SEO checks

- Confirm the draft answers the search intent behind the target keyword. If the ranking pages are comparisons and our draft is a sales page, flag it.

- Target keyword present in the H1, the first 100 words, the meta title and two or three H2s, placed naturally and never stuffed.

- Meta title and meta description within length, keyword front-loaded, appearing once, no filler calls to action.

- Correct heading hierarchy with no skipped levels.

- Internal links to the relevant service pages, with descriptive anchor text.

- Flag missing or unsourced claims and any section that is too thin to stand.



Business and compliance

- Place calls to action strategically, for example after treatments, after benefits, and after the "why choose us" section, rather than one block at the end.

- For healthcare clients, ensure the copy complies with the Healthcare Services (Advertisement) Regulations. Flag superlatives, guarantees, comparative claims and testimonials that cannot stand.



Preferred Skills

- Minimum 1 year of editing experience. Agency or content-marketing experience preferred.

- Working knowledge of SEO. Deep technical SEO is a bonus, not a requirement.

- Able to drive AI tools well (ChatGPT, Claude or similar), and more importantly able to tell when the output is generic and fix it.

- Comfortable working from a brief and a style guide without hand-holding.

- Excellent written English, native or near-native fluency.

- Able to switch between US and UK spelling on instruction.

- Bonus: healthcare or finance content experience.



How to Apply

- Please attach your CV and two published pieces you edited, and name one of them you are still proud of.

- Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

title: Land Analyst - U.S. Land Acquisition
description:
Land Analyst – U.S. Land Acquisition

Remote | Full-Time | Independent Contractor

Compensation: US$1,500/month



About Principal Acres

Principal Acres is a U.S.-based land acquisition company that specializes in acquiring vacant land across the United States.

We are looking for a Land Analyst to join our acquisitions team and help us research, analyze, and evaluate potential land acquisition opportunities.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys research, property data, numbers, problem-solving, and finding the details that matter.



What You'll Do:

• Research vacant land properties across the United States.

• Analyze county records, assessor information, tax records, parcel/APN information, and other property data.

• Research recent land sales and comparable properties to help determine market value.

• Review acreage, location, access, zoning, utilities, structures, and other relevant property characteristics.

• Research property ownership and verify seller/property information.

• Conduct preliminary due diligence on potential acquisitions.

• Identify property risks, inconsistencies, missing information, and potential red flags.

• Analyze whether properties meet Principal Acres' acquisition criteria.

• Prepare clear property analysis reports and acquisition summaries.

• Maintain accurate property information in the CRM and other Company systems.

• Work closely with the Acquisition Manager to support acquisition decisions.

• Prioritize properties that appear to have strong acquisition potential.



What We're Looking For:

• Excellent English - written and verbal.

• Strong analytical and research skills.

• Exceptional attention to detail.

• Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills.

• Comfortable working with large amounts of data.

• Comfortable learning CRM systems and online property research platforms.

• Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving ability.

• Able to work independently and manage assigned research.

• Highly organized and disciplined.

• Self-motivated and reliable.



Experience with any of the following is highly desirable:

• U.S. real estate

• Land acquisition

• Property research

• Real estate investing

• Due diligence

• Property valuation

• GIS / mapping

• U.S. county records

• Assessor or recorder websites

• Comparable-sales research



U.S. land experience is preferred, but we are willing to train the right analytical candidate who demonstrates strong research ability and attention to detail.



The Type of Person We're Looking For:

We're not looking for someone who simply collects information.

We want someone who can look at the information, identify what matters, spot potential problems, and explain what the data means.

You should naturally be asking:

"Is this actually a property we should pursue?"

You should enjoy digging into information until you understand the property and can give the acquisitions team a clear, well-supported answer.



Success in this role will be measured by:

• Accuracy of property research

• Quality of comparable-sales analysis

• Number of properties successfully analyzed

• Turnaround time on assigned research

• Identification of property risks and red flags

• Accuracy of CRM and property records

• Quality of acquisition summaries

• Ability to identify and prioritize promising opportunities

• Reliability and consistency



Compensation & Working Arrangement

US$1,500 per month

• Full-time remote position

• Independent contractor

• Work with a U.S.-based land acquisition company

• Company-provided systems and tools

• Long-term opportunity for the right person



Important:

This is a research and analysis role, not a sales position.

You will be expected to work independently, pay close attention to detail, meet deadlines, and communicate clearly with the acquisitions team.

If you love research, real estate, data, and solving problems, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Creative Marketing Assistant
description:
I am looking for an experienced Creative Marketing Assistant with strong graphic design and video editing skills to join our growing remote marketing team, "Engageify Marketing".



This is a full-time, hands-on creative role for someone who can turn marketing concepts, campaign ideas, and creative direction into polished visual assets that are professional, on-brand, and designed to support specific marketing goals.



You will work across graphic design, video editing, social media content, landing pages, websites,
 campaigns, presentations, lead magnets, and other digital marketing initiatives.



We are looking for more than someone who simply knows how to use Canva or basic video editing software. You should understand how to create marketing materials that are visually strong, communicate clearly, follow brand standards, and encourage the audience to take action.



You will support multiple client accounts, so organization, communication, attention to detail, creativity, and the ability to manage projects without constant supervision are essential.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to grow with Engageify Marketing and take on increasing creative and marketing responsibility as their skills and performance develop.



What You'll Do

1. Graphic Design and Creative Production

Create professional, conversion-focused graphics for social media, paid advertising campaigns, websites, landing pages, funnels,
 campaigns, and other marketing initiatives.

Design social media posts, advertisements, thumbnails, presentations, lead magnets, brochures, guides, promotional materials, and branded digital assets.

Translate creative briefs, campaign concepts, and marketing objectives into clean and effective visual designs.

Follow client brand guidelines while maintaining consistency across colors, typography, imagery, spacing, layout, and overall visual identity.

Adapt creative assets into multiple sizes and formats for
, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, websites,
 campaigns, and other platforms.

Create and edit photos, graphics, illustrations, icons, layouts, and visual assets as needed.

Improve existing designs based on feedback, campaign objectives, and creative direction.

Review designs from the audience's perspective and identify opportunities to improve clarity, visual hierarchy, engagement, and conversion.

Maintain organized design templates, brand assets, client folders, and creative libraries.



2. Video Editing and Production

Edit both short-form and long-form marketing videos.

Create video content for Reels, Shorts, YouTube, testimonials, interviews, educational videos, and promotional campaigns.

Turn raw footage into polished, professional, and engaging video content.

Add captions, graphics, text animations, transitions, B-roll, music, sound effects, and other visual elements where appropriate.

Create engaging hooks and opening sequences designed to capture attention.

Edit and improve audio quality when needed.

Maintain strong pacing, storytelling, branding, and visual consistency throughout each video.

Format and optimize videos for different platforms, placements, and aspect ratios.

Create thumbnails and supporting visual assets for video content.

Complete revisions efficiently based on internal or client feedback.

Organize raw footage, completed videos, project files, and creative assets properly.



3. Marketing and Campaign Support

Support the creative execution of digital marketing campaigns across multiple client accounts.

Assist with content creation, campaign concepts, visual direction, and creative ideas.

Create and organize creative assets needed for paid advertising campaigns.

Support basic formatting and updates inside GoHighLevel, including landing pages, funnels, forms,
s, SMS messages, and media assets.

Coordinate graphics and videos with landing pages, advertisements,
s, social media campaigns, and other parts of the customer journey.

Assist with website and landing page visual updates when needed.

Help prepare creative assets for presentations, downloadable guides, lead magnets, reports, and marketing materials.

Review creative work before publishing to ensure branding, spelling, formatting, sizing, and overall quality are correct.

Manage multiple creative assignments, revisions, and deadlines while maintaining consistent quality.

Communicate project progress, questions, and creative recommendations proactively.

Support additional marketing and operational projects as needed.



The Ideal Candidate Will Have

-Strong hands-on graphic design experience with a professional portfolio demonstrating real marketing work.

-Strong video editing experience with examples of both short-form and long-form content.

-Strong experience using Canva to create professional marketing materials.

-Hands-on experience with professional creative software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After -Effects, Descript, or similar platforms.

-A strong eye for branding, typography, layout, spacing, imagery, composition, visual hierarchy, and consistency.

-Experience creating marketing materials for social media, paid advertising, websites, landing pages, or digital campaigns.

-An understanding that effective marketing creative should support a specific goal and not simply look attractive.

-Ability to take creative direction and turn it into polished, professional deliverables.

-Ability to follow established brand guidelines while still bringing creativity and new ideas to projects.

-Ability to receive feedback professionally and make revisions efficiently.

-Strong attention to detail and a consistent quality assurance process.

-Ability to manage multiple client projects, creative assignments, and deadlines at the same time.

-Ability to work independently while communicating progress, questions, challenges, and recommendations proactively.

-Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills.

-Strong file organization and project management habits.

-A reliable computer capable of handling graphic design and video editing work.

-Stable internet connection and a professional remote work environment.

-Availability to consistently work 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.



Strongly Preferred Creative Tools & Experience

Experience with several of the following will make you a stronger candidate:

-Canva

-Adobe Premiere Pro

-Adobe After Effects

-Adobe Photoshop

-Adobe Illustrator

-Adobe InDesign

-Adobe Audition

-Adobe Lightroom

-Descript

-CapCut

-GoHighLevel



Other professional graphic design and video editing platforms

-AI-assisted graphic design and video editing tools

-Motion graphics and animation

-Photo editing and image manipulation

-Audio editing and enhancement

-Social media content creation

-Paid advertising creative

-Video thumbnails and promotional graphics

-Landing page and website graphics


 marketing creative

-Presentation and lead magnet design

-Brochure, booklet, guide, and PDF layout design

-Agency or multi-client creative production

-Real estate marketing



NOTE: Candidates do not need to be experts in every platform listed above. We place greater importance on strong creative fundamentals, professional design and video editing ability, marketing judgment, attention to detail, reliability, communication, and the ability to learn new tools quickly.



Candidates should also be comfortable sharing their screen and presenting graphic design and video editing projects they personally created during the interview process. We want to understand not only what you can create, but also your creative process, design decisions, ability to follow branding, how you handle feedback, and how you approach marketing objectives.



Compensation: $6.00 USD per hour



How to Apply

Please send the following:

-Your resume or a summary of your relevant work experience

-A brief introduction describing your graphic design and video editing experience

-A link to your graphic design portfolio

-Examples of short-form video editing work

-Your current internet speed and computer specifications

-Confirmation that you can work 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday

-Confirmation that you are willing to participate in a one-hour virtual interview with structured questions and a portfolio showcase

-Please include the phrase “Creative Marketing Assistant” in the subject line of your application.



Applications without relevant graphic design and video editing work samples may not be considered.



Who We Are

Engageify Marketing is a full-service marketing team that helps businesses generate leads, strengthen their brand, and grow through connected marketing systems.We bring together strategy, paid advertising, funnels, CRM, automation, content, creative, and performance tracking so every part of the customer journey works together.We value people who take ownership, think creatively, communicate proactively, and care about doing great work. Our team combines creativity, technical skill, accountability, and continuous improvement to deliver meaningful results for our clients.

description:

 will not be considered.



What You'll Be Doing:

- Source suitable venues across the UK for seminars and events.

- Research venues based on location, capacity, facilities, availability, and budget.

- Contact venue managers and suppliers to explore rates, packages, and partnership opportunities.

- Negotiate discounts, complimentary spaces, and other cost-effective arrangements where possible.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with UK venues and event suppliers.

- Maintain an organised database of venues, contacts, pricing, and terms.

- Coordinate with the wider team on upcoming seminar and venue requirements.

- Research alternative venues when needed and help ensure events have suitable options.

- Support the company's social media accounts by responding to comments and messages on
 and Instagram.

- Monitor and respond to reviews across Google and
, escalating any issues where appropriate.

- Provide regular administrative and operational support to the wider team.

- Data entry, record keeping, research, follow-ups, and other day-to-day administrative tasks.

- Support the team with general coordination and other responsibilities associated with the role.



You should be:

- Have at least 5 years of experience in venue sourcing, events, conferences, hospitality, or a closely related field.

- Have previous UK venue sourcing experience — preferably within the UK events or hospitality industry.

- Strongly familiar with UK geography and locations.

- Confident communicating with venue managers, suppliers, and external contacts.

- Comfortable negotiating rates, discounts, and commercial arrangements.

- Naturally good at building and maintaining professional relationships.

- Resourceful and able to identify creative venue and partnership opportunities.

- Highly organised and detail-oriented.

- Confident communicating professionally across telephone,
, and social media.

- Comfortable responding to customer comments, messages, and online reviews.

- Able to work independently while communicating effectively with the wider team.

- A reliable team player who is willing to take ownership of both sourcing and administrative responsibilities.



- The Ideal Candidate -



The ideal candidate understands that venue sourcing is about more than finding somewhere available.

You know how to assess whether a venue is right for an event, identify the right person to speak to, build rapport, and negotiate an arrangement that works for both sides.



You're comfortable asking questions such as:

"What can you offer us if we're bringing multiple events to your venue?"**



You won't simply accept the first price you're given. You'll look for opportunities to negotiate a better rate, complimentary space, additional benefits, or a longer-term partnership.



You're commercially minded without being pushy, professional without being overly formal, and genuinely enjoy building relationships with suppliers.



Most importantly, you're someone who takes ownership and finds solutions

Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM UK Time, Monday to Friday (4:00 PM - 12:00 AM PH Time)

Break: 30-minute paid lunch break

Employment: Full-time only

- Reliable laptop or desktop computer.

- Windows: Intel Core i5 processor or higher.

- Mac:Apple M1 chip or higher.



2. Audio

- Good-quality headset suitable for professional telephone calls/meetings.



3. Internet

- Stable primary internet connection.

- Backup internet source, such as a secondary ISP or reliable mobile hotspot.



Benefits & Culture:

- 28 days annual leave — inclusive of 8 Bank Holidays and 20 paid holidays. Holiday entitlement is pro-rated.

- Dedicated wellness support.

- WFH benefits after successfully completing probation.

- Additional company benefits will be discussed during induction training.



HOW TO APPLY:

1. Resume/CV Link

2. Loom/Video Introduction — 3–5 minutes

Please record a video answering the following:

- Introduce yourself.

- Tell us about your professional background.

- Why do you believe you would be an excellent fit for this specific Venue Sourcing & Events Coordinator role at Clark & Wright?

- What experience do you have with venue sourcing, events, or supplier management?

- Are you comfortable with the stated PHP 50,000 - PHP 60,000 monthly salary?



Please note: A voice recording alone will not be accepted. We require a video introduction.

The brand look is clean and friendly, with inspiration from Anthropologie Home, Rifle Paper Co., and Montessori.

If you have a sharp eye for visual hierarchy, balance, and alignment, and take pride in getting the tiny details right, you'll thrive here!

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR) / Business Development Representative (BDR)
description:
Sales Development Representative (SDR) / Business Development Representative (BDR)



Work Setup: Remote

Schedule: Part-Time — 20 Hours per Week

Primary Focus: Lead Generation, Prospect Qualification, Lead Nurturing, Pipeline Management, and Appointment Setting



Position Overview



We are looking for a professional, organized, and AI-comfortable Sales Development Representative (SDR) / Business Development Representative (BDR) to support the sales pipeline for two innovative AI solutions:



School Concierge AI — serving the U.S. K–12 education market

e-Discovery AI — serving legal, compliance, records-management, and litigation-support environments



This role goes beyond cold calling and appointment setting. The selected candidate must understand how to move prospects through the sales journey—from initial research and outreach to relationship-building, qualification, ongoing nurturing, and appointment conversion.



The ideal candidate is confident communicating with U.S.-based prospects, understands B2B sales development, and can build trust through consistent, thoughtful follow-up. They should also be comfortable using approved AI tools to improve prospect research, call preparation, outreach personalization, follow-ups, and productivity.



Key Responsibilities

Research and identify potential prospects within the U.S. K–12 education, legal, compliance, and professional-services markets

Identify key decision-makers within schools, school districts, law firms, legal departments, and businesses

Conduct outbound cold calls, warm calls,
s, and LinkedIn outreach using approved scripts and messaging

Introduce solutions clearly and confidently while tailoring conversations to each prospect’s needs

Qualify leads based on their needs, challenges, authority, interest, timing, and potential fit

Understand each prospect’s position within the sales funnel and determine the appropriate next step

Build relationships with prospects who may not be ready to schedule an appointment immediately

Nurture warm and long-term leads through consistent, value-driven follow-ups

Re-engage unresponsive, inactive, or previously contacted prospects

Address initial questions and objections using approved sales materials and objection-handling guides

Schedule qualified discovery calls, demonstrations, and follow-up meetings with the leadership team

Maintain accurate CRM or pipeline records, including contact information, call notes, objections, lead status, follow-up dates, and next steps

Track daily outreach activities, conversations, qualified leads, follow-ups, and scheduled appointments

Collaborate with leadership to improve outreach strategies, messaging, scripts, and lead-nurturing sequences

Participate in product, sales, CRM, script, qualification, and objection-handling training

Follow all confidentiality, privacy, and responsible data-handling requirements

Qualifications

Strong spoken and written English with professional communication skills

Previous experience in sales development, business development, B2B outreach, cold calling, lead generation, appointment setting, telemarketing, or sales support

Understanding of the sales funnel and how to move leads from initial contact to qualification and conversion

Experience nurturing leads through multiple calls,
s, or follow-up touchpoints

Ability to build rapport and maintain relationships without using overly aggressive sales tactics

Comfortable communicating with prospects during agreed-upon U.S. business hours

Able to follow scripts and sales processes while sounding natural, warm, curious, and confident

Strong listening, research, organization, and note-taking skills

Able to recognize prospect needs, buying signals, concerns, and objections

Disciplined with follow-ups, pipeline management, and activity tracking

Comfortable using AI tools responsibly to support sales activities

Reliable, professional, coachable, goal-oriented, and receptive to feedback

Willing to learn about the U.S. K–12 education and legal/e-Discovery markets

Tools You Should Know or Be Willing to Learn

ChatGPT and Perplexity

Google Workspace or Microsoft 365

LinkedIn

CRM and sales-pipeline management platforms

Zoom or Google Meet

Phone or VoIP calling platforms

Internal tracking systems and shared documents



Experience with Claude, Apollo, Seamless.AI, Notion, Trello, Asana, ClickUp, Canva, or similar tools is a plus.

title: Data Scientist
description:
// The work



We make financial research videos. You build the data layer underneath them: pulling the numbers, cleaning them, and turning them into charts and information design that titles, thumbnails, and scripts get built on.



Most of this job is code. You'll be scraping SEC filings, hitting APIs, wrangling messy financial data into something structured, and producing charts from it. If you can't write the prompt that gets the data, this role won't work.



You don't need to be a finance expert. You need to be fluent with data and fast at learning. We teach you the rest.



/// What you'll do



Pull data from filings, APIs, and the web — write the scraper, handle the pagination, deal with the garbage formatting.

Clean and structure it. Reconcile inconsistencies across sources and periods.

Build charts and information design from it. Not screenshots of spreadsheets — designed visuals.

Dig into a trend and figure out what's actually in the data. Come back with a finding, not a dump.

Help shape the angle: what's the story, and why should anyone care.

Chase answers on your own. Come back with progress, not just questions.



/// What we need



Python and pandas. Comfortable, not "I did a course." You've built things.

Real scraping experience — requests/BeautifulSoup/Playwright, whatever you use. You've dealt with sites that don't want to be scraped.

You can produce a chart in code (matplotlib, plotly, D3, Observable — your choice) and you have taste about how it looks.

SQL is a plus. JavaScript is a plus. Working with financial data is a plus.

High agency. You move without being told. You go one layer deeper than asked.

Clear written English. We work async.



We can teach the domain. We can't teach agency, and we're not teaching you to code.



/// Not for you if



Your data work stops at Excel.

You need a BI tool to make a chart.

You need every task fully specified.

You go quiet when you get stuck.



/// To apply



Start with the word CADMIUM so we know you read this far.



Then do this, it should take you under an hour:



Pick any US-listed company. Pull its last 8 quarters of revenue from its SEC filings — by code, not by hand. Make one chart from it. Send us the code and the chart.



We don't care if the chart is beautiful. We care that the data came out of a script you wrote, and that the chart makes one point clearly.



Also tell us: one thing you taught yourself recently, and how.



We read applications that follow these steps. We skip the ones that don't.
